  • Assessment Templates - Configure assessment fields
  • Group Settings - Configure your group

docs.title: Admin: Grade Depth Chart
docs.text:
Access Level

Selector can view grade tiers and scores, drag reorder, lock/unlock, suppress/restore, set availability, clear overrides, and enter subjective scores. Owner can also recalculate the grade.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Use Grade Chart to manage tier ranking for one grade in a selected season.

The page groups officials into five tier columns and lets selectors apply manual overrides.

docs.title: How to Access
docs.text: From the sidebar, expand Depth Charting, then click Grade Chart.

docs.title: Before You Start
docs.text:
• Select both a Season and Grade.
  • Use Subgroup if you need to filter to one subgroup.
  • If no data appears, run Recalculate Grade (Owner access required).

docs.title: Filters
docs.text:
• Season
  • Grade
  • Subgroup (if configured)

Captured 25 October 2026.

docs.title: Tier Columns
docs.text:
The chart shows five tier columns (names and colours can be customised):

  • Tier 1
  • Tier 2
  • Tier 3
  • Tier 4
  • Tier 5

Each official row includes:

  • Rank
  • Official name
  • Depth score button (opens Score Breakdown)
  • Optional score split bar (calculated vs subjective)
  • Selector actions

docs.title: Selector Actions
docs.text:
Selectors can:

  • Drag officials to reorder ranks
  • Set Avail score (0.0 to 10.0)
  • Lock or unlock an official
  • Suppress or restore an official
  • Enter subjective scores
  • Clear all overrides for the current scope

Captured 25 October 2026. Names and scores shown are fictional.

docs.title: Fields and Inputs
docs.text:
Season, required

  • Chooses the season used for ranking and score data

Grade, required

  • Chooses which grade chart to display

Subgroup, optional

  • Filters the chart to a specific subgroup

Avail, required when edited

  • Slider from 0 to 10
  • Saved in 0.5 steps

Scores: Score (0-100), optional per metric

  • Only saved for metrics where a score is entered

Scores: Notes, optional

  • Free text notes per metric

docs.title: Load a Grade Chart
docs.text:
1. Open Depth Charting > Grade Chart.
  2. Select Season.
  3. Select Grade.
  4. Optionally select Subgroup.
  5. Result: Tier cards load for that scope.

docs.title: Reorder Officials (Selector)
docs.text:
1. Drag an official using the drag handle.
  2. Drop the official into the desired position.
  3. Result: Order saves automatically and rank badges update.

docs.title: Lock or Unlock an Official (Selector)
docs.text:
1. Click the lock button in the official row.
  2. Result: If locked, the official is pinned during recalculation. If unlocked, rank can move during recalculation.

docs.title: Hide or Restore an Official (Selector)
docs.text:
1. Click the eye button in the official row.
  2. Result: Hidden officials are not shown in published view. Visible officials are restored to normal display.

docs.title: Adjust Availability (Selector)
docs.text:
1. Move the Avail slider in the official row.
  2. Release the slider.
  3. Result: Availability is saved and confirmation appears.

docs.title: Enter Subjective Scores (Selector)
docs.text:
1. Click Scores in the official row.
  2. Enter score values (0 to 100) for one or more metrics.
  3. Add optional notes.
  4. Click Save Scores.
  5. Result: Scores save and chart updates.

docs.title: Bulk Apply Subjective Score (Selector)
docs.text:
1. Click Bulk Score.
  2. Select Metric.
  3. Enter Score (0-100) and optional notes.
  4. Tick one or more officials.
  5. Click Apply Score.
  6. Result: Score is applied to selected officials in the current chart scope.

docs.title: Clear All Overrides (Selector)
docs.text:
1. Click Clear Overrides.
  2. Confirm the prompt.
  3. Result: Manual ranking overrides are removed for the current scope.

docs.title: Recalculate This Grade (Owner)
docs.text:
1. Click Recalculate Grade.
  2. Wait for completion.
  3. Result: Chart is recalculated and refreshed.

docs.title: Export Grade CSV
docs.text:
1. Load the chart with your required season/grade/subgroup.
  2. Click Export CSV.
  3. Result: Grade chart data downloads as a CSV file.

docs.title: Validation and Rules
docs.text:
• You must select both Season and Grade before loading
  • Search requires at least 2 characters
  • Subjective scores must be between 0 and 100
  • Bulk score requires at least one selected official
  • Availability is entered on a 0 to 10 scale

docs.title: Chart does not load
docs.text:
Symptoms The chart stays empty or you see a load error.

How to Fix

  1. Check that both Season and Grade are selected.
  2. If needed, reload the page.
  3. If you have Owner access, run Recalculate Grade.

Common Causes

  • Required filters were not selected
  • Chart data has not been recalculated for that scope

docs.title: Cannot move a row
docs.text:
Symptoms Dragging does not change order for a row.

How to Fix

  1. Confirm you have Selector access.
  2. Check whether the official is locked.
  3. Unlock the official if rank movement is needed.

Common Causes

  • User does not have selector permissions
  • Official is locked (pinned)

docs.title: Related Pages
docs.text:
• Admin: Depth Charting Overview, cross-grade ranking and coverage
  • Admin: Score Breakdown, inspect one official's score factors
  • Admin: Depth Scoring Config, configure scoring and tiers

How to Access From the sidebar, expand Depth Charting.

docs.title: Admin: Depth Charting Overview
docs.text:
Access Level

Selector can view rankings and coverage, set manual rank order, and enter subjective scores. Owner can also run full recalculation and update historical seasons.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Use Overview to review cross-grade rankings for a season, follow officials' career progression, and manage historical season calculations.

This page shows:

  • Overall rank order across all grades
  • Each official's best grade and depth score
  • Grade coverage summary
  • Manual rank movement (for selectors)
  • Career progression by season, grade, score, and rank
  • Historical season calculation progress

Captured 25 October 2026.

docs.title: How to Access
docs.text: From the sidebar, expand Depth Charting, then click Overview.

docs.title: Before You Start
docs.text:
• Select a season from the Season list before using the table.
  • If no rankings appear, run a recalculation first (Owner access required).
  • Subjective scoring buttons appear only when your group has active subjective metrics.

docs.title: Grade Coverage
docs.text:
The Grade Coverage panel shows one chip per grade with tier counts.

  • Click a grade chip to open that grade in Grade Chart
  • Border colours show coverage health at a glance

docs.title: Overall Ranking
docs.text:
The Overall Ranking table shows:

  • Rank
  • Official
  • Best Grade
  • Depth Score
  • Subgroups
  • Subjective Scoring (selectors only, when metrics exist)

Captured 25 October 2026. Names and results shown are fictional.

docs.title: Career Progression
docs.text:
Select the Career Progression tab to compare calculated scores and ranks across seasons. The default view is Graph; choose Table to view season-by-season values in rows.

Choose a From season, To season, Ranking, and Official, then click Apply. Overall ranking compares officials across grades using each official's best grade for that season. Selecting a grade shows progression for that grade. In Table view, click a column heading to sort the rows.

The graphs show Score by season and Rank by season. Click an official's name in the legend to focus on them. Use Ctrl-click or Cmd-click to add or remove officials, Shift-click to select a range, or click Show all to restore every official.

Historical values are reconstructed using the current scoring rules and the activity options currently enabled for diaries, assessments, and plans. The experience factor uses all-time activity. These values therefore do not show what the score or ranking was at the time.

Score change compares the score with the previous consecutive season. Rank movement compares rank with that same season; a positive value means movement towards rank 1. Both values are blank when the previous consecutive season has no calculated result.

docs.title: Historical season progress
docs.text:
Use Backfill All Seasons to calculate rankings for all eligible seasons with activity in the selected organisation, including the current season when eligible. While the job runs, the progress card shows completed and failed season-and-grade calculations and the current calculation. The card disappears when the update succeeds; if errors remain, it stays visible and offers Retry failed scopes. Existing selector ordering and availability settings are kept.

If any calculations fail, click Retry failed scopes after the job finishes. The retry runs the failed season-and-grade calculations again.

docs.title: Search Official
docs.text:
Use Search official... in the page header to find an official in the current season table.

  • Type at least 2 characters
  • Click a result to jump to and highlight that row

docs.title: Fields and Inputs
docs.text:
Season, required

  • Chooses which season rankings and coverage are loaded

From season, required for Career Progression

  • Sets the first season in the comparison range

To season, required for Career Progression

  • Sets the last season in the comparison range; it must be the same as or later than From season

Ranking, optional

  • Overall ranking compares each official's best grade across the group; choose a grade to view that grade's results

Official, optional

  • Limits results to one official

Bulk Score: Metric, required

  • Selects which subjective metric score to apply

Bulk Score: Score (0-100), required

  • Must be between 0 and 100

Bulk Score: Notes, optional

  • Adds optional notes with the score

Bulk Score: Apply to, required

  • All grades applies to each selected official in all grades they are ranked in
  • Best grade only applies only to each selected official's best grade

docs.title: Load Overview for a Season
docs.text:
1. Open Depth Charting > Overview.
  2. Select a value in Season.
  3. Wait for the ranking table and coverage chips to load.
  4. Result: You see the season's overall ranking and grade coverage.

docs.title: Enter Subjective Scores for One Official (Selector)
docs.text:
1. In the official row, click Edit in Subjective Scoring.
  2. Enter score values in Score (0-100).
  3. Add optional notes.
  4. Click Save Scores.
  5. Result: Scores are saved for that official and a confirmation appears.

docs.title: Bulk Apply Subjective Score (Selector)
docs.text:
1. Click Bulk Score.
  2. Select Metric.
  3. Enter Score (0-100).
  4. Choose All grades or Best grade only.
  5. Tick one or more officials.
  6. Click Apply Score.
  7. Result: The score is applied to selected officials.

docs.title: Reorder Overall Ranking (Selector)
docs.text:
1. Drag rows using the handle at the left of each row.
  2. Drop each row in your preferred order.
  3. Result: Order saves automatically and a success message appears.

docs.title: Reset Manual Overall Ordering (Selector)
docs.text:
1. Click Reset Order.
  2. Confirm the prompt.
  3. Result: Manual order is removed and ranking returns to automatic score order.

docs.title: Export Overall Ranking
docs.text:
1. Select a season.
  2. Click Export CSV.
  3. Result: The season's overall ranking downloads as a CSV file.

docs.title: Recalculate All Grades (administrative access)
docs.text:
1. Click Recalculate.
  2. Wait for progress to finish for each grade.
  3. Result: Rankings are rebuilt and the page refreshes with new results.

docs.title: View Career Progression
docs.text:
1. Open Depth Charting > Overview.
  2. Select the Career Progression tab.
  3. Choose a From season and To season. The ending season must be the same as or later than the starting season.
  4. Optionally select a Ranking or Official.
  5. Click Apply.
  6. Choose Graph or Table to change how results are displayed.
  7. Result: You see calculated scores and rankings for the selected seasons and filters.

docs.title: Update Historical Seasons (administrative access)
docs.text:
1. Open Depth Charting > Overview.
  2. Click Backfill All Seasons.
  3. Review the confirmation for your organisation, then click Backfill seasons.
  4. Follow progress in Historical season progress. The job may take a while.
  5. If the job reports errors, click Retry failed scopes.
  6. Result: Eligible season rankings are recalculated using the current scoring rules and diary, assessment, and plan activity settings. Selector ordering and availability settings remain in place.

docs.title: Validation and Rules
docs.text:
• Search requires at least 2 characters
  • From season and To season are required; the ending season must not be earlier than the starting season
  • Ranking and Official are optional filters
  • Bulk score must be between 0 and 100
  • At least one official must be selected for bulk score
  • Manual ordering is available to selectors only
  • Career Progression only includes calculated depth chart data for the selected seasons
  • Historical backfill requires administrative access
  • Historical backfill recalculates eligible seasons with current settings; it does not recreate past settings
  • Score change and rank movement are shown only when the previous consecutive season also has calculated data

docs.title: No depth chart data for this season yet
docs.text:
Symptoms The page shows no ranking rows for the selected season.

How to Fix

  1. Confirm the correct Season is selected.
  2. If you have administrative access, click Recalculate.
  3. Reload the page after recalculation completes.

Common Causes

  • Rankings have not been calculated yet for that season
  • The selected season has no eligible data yet

docs.title: Bulk score will not save
docs.text:
Symptoms You see a warning when applying a bulk score.

How to Fix

  1. Enter a score from 0 to 100.
  2. Tick at least one official.
  3. Confirm a metric is selected.

Common Causes

  • Score is blank or outside range
  • No officials were selected

docs.title: Career Progression has no results
docs.text:
Symptoms The table or graphs show that there is no calculated trend data.

How to Fix

  1. Check the selected season range and filters.
  2. If you have administrative access, run Recalculate for the selected season or Backfill All Seasons for all eligible seasons.
  3. Apply the filters again after the calculation finishes.

Common Causes

  • Depth chart calculations have not been run for those seasons
  • The selected grade or official has no calculated data in that range

docs.title: Related Pages
docs.text:
• Admin: Grade Depth Chart, manage one grade in detail
  • Admin: Score Breakdown, view per-factor scoring for one official
  • Admin: Depth Scoring Config, configure weights, tiers and metrics
  • Home, view the depth coverage summary for administrators

How to Access From the sidebar, expand Depth Charting.

docs.title: Admin: Score Breakdown
docs.text:
Access Level

Selector and Owner can view breakdown details.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Use Score Breakdown to see how one official's depth score was calculated.

This page helps you understand:

  • Current total score and tier
  • Rank position
  • Score split between calculated and subjective components
  • Per-factor contribution by section

docs.title: How to Access
docs.text:
From the sidebar, expand Depth Charting, then click Score Breakdown.

You can also open this page from score buttons in Overview or Grade Chart.

docs.title: Before You Start
docs.text:
• If you open this page directly, search and select an official first.
  • If breakdown data does not exist yet, run recalculation for that grade.

docs.title: Select Official
docs.text:
When no official is selected yet, the page shows Select Official.

  • Type at least 2 characters
  • Click an official name to open their breakdown

docs.title: Official Header
docs.text:
The header shows:

  • Official name and profile image
  • Grade selector
  • Season selector
  • Subgroup label (if relevant)
  • Rank
  • Calculated date
  • Total score and tier badge

docs.title: Score Split Bar
docs.text:
When subjective scores are present, the split bar shows:

  • Calculated portion
  • Subjective portion

docs.title: Breakdown Cards
docs.text:
Factors are grouped into:

  • General
  • Diary
  • Assessments
  • Plans
  • Subjective (only if subjective metrics exist for that score)

Captured 25 October 2026.

Each factor row shows:

  • Factor name
  • Progress bar
  • Raw/max
  • Weight
  • Earned
  • Potential

docs.title: AI Summaries
docs.text:
When the AI features add-on and Breakdown Summary access are enabled, an AI Summary appears above each available Diary, Assessments, and Plans table. The first summary is generated automatically from written entries for the selected official and season.

The summary provides reading context only. It does not change any score, weight, tier, or rank. It starts with a short overview and may include evidence-based Strengths and Development areas lists, with no more than four bullets in each. Unsupported sections are omitted.

The Sources list links to the records used and identifies records from an earlier season. Links open through the normal review workflow, so existing access permissions apply. Season labels use the date range configured for the association. When a season has too few written entries, the summary uses entries from that season first and fills the remaining range with recent written entries from the immediately preceding season.

Captured 25 October 2026. The official, source record and summary content are fictional.

To change how many recent entries are summarised:

  1. Find AI Summary in the required breakdown card.
  2. Select an available range, such as Last 3, Last 5, or Last 10.
  3. Click Re-summarise.
  4. Result: MOS refreshes the narrative using that section and range.

If there are no shared entries, or the entries have no written content, MOS shows that instead of generating a narrative. See AI Features for access settings, limitations, and troubleshooting.

docs.title: Find an Official and Open Breakdown
docs.text:
1. Open Depth Charting > Score Breakdown.
  2. In Select Official, type at least 2 characters.
  3. Click the official.
  4. Result: The page opens that official's score breakdown.

docs.title: View Another Grade or Season for the Same Official
docs.text:
1. Use the Grade selector in the header.
  2. Use the Season selector in the header.
  3. Result: Breakdown refreshes for the selected scope.

docs.title: Return to the Source Chart
docs.text:
1. Click Grade Chart to return to that grade chart scope.
  2. Or click Overview to return to the overall ranking page.

docs.title: Validation and Rules
docs.text:
• Search requires at least 2 characters
  • Breakdown can only display where a score record exists for that official and scope
  • If breakdown factors are not yet generated, recalculation is required

docs.title: No breakdown data yet
docs.text:
Symptoms You see: "No breakdown data yet. Run a recalculation for this grade to generate per-factor scores."

How to Fix

  1. Open Grade Chart for the same grade and season.
  2. If you have Owner access, click Recalculate Grade.
  3. Return to Score Breakdown and refresh.

Common Causes

  • The grade has not been recalculated yet for that season

docs.title: Official not found in selected scope
docs.text:
Symptoms You see an error that no score record was found for the selected scope.

How to Fix

  1. Change Grade and/or Season in the header.
  2. Confirm the official is ranked in that scope.
  3. Try opening the official from Grade Chart instead.

Common Causes

  • Official has no depth score for the chosen grade or season

docs.title: Related Pages
docs.text:
• AI Features - Configure and understand the AI summaries used on this page
  • Admin: Grade Depth Chart, manage grade-level ranking and overrides
  • Admin: Depth Charting Overview, manage cross-grade ranking
  • Admin: Depth Scoring Config, configure scoring rules

How to Access From the sidebar, expand Depth Charting.

docs.title: Admin: Depth Scoring Config
docs.text:
Access Level

Owner access required. Selector can manage ranking actions in depth chart pages but cannot change scoring configuration.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Use Scoring Config to control how depth scores and tiers are calculated for your group.

This page lets you manage:

  • Grade prestige weight
  • Scoring weights and tier thresholds
  • Subgroup inclusion and subgroup weight
  • Subjective metrics
  • Tier names and colours

Captured 25 October 2026.

docs.title: How to Access
docs.text: From the sidebar, expand Depth Charting, then click Scoring Config.

docs.title: Before You Start
docs.text:
• Changes here affect depth chart behaviour across the group.
  • Career Progression explains historical scores using the current scoring rules and activity options. If you update historical seasons, those seasons are recalculated with the settings currently saved here.
  • Use Save buttons in each tab after editing.
  • For scoring weights, totals must equal 100 before saving.

docs.title: Tab: Grade Prestige
docs.text: Use this tab to set each grade's Level Weight.

docs.title: Fields
docs.text:
Level Weight, required

  • Range: 0.1 to 10
  • Higher values increase a grade's influence in cross-grade ranking

docs.title: Task: Save Grade Prestige Weight
docs.text:
1. Open Grade Prestige.
  2. Enter a Level Weight for a grade.
  3. Click Save in that row.
  4. Result: Prestige weight is saved.

docs.title: Tab: Scoring Weights
docs.text: Use this tab to set per-grade scoring rules.

docs.title: Fields
docs.text:
Grade, required

  • Selects which grade config you are editing

Weight fields, required

  • All enabled weight fields together must total exactly 100

Tier thresholds, required

  • Must follow descending order: Tier 1 > Tier 2 > Tier 3 > Tier 4

Auto-scale thresholds by grade prestige, optional

  • When enabled, lower-prestige grades use scaled threshold values

docs.title: Important Rules
docs.text:
• Disabled lifecycle/feedback factors show as Disabled - 0 pts earned
  • Disabled factors are set to zero and cannot be edited
  • Balance redistributes enabled weights to total 100, then saves
  • Save as New Version creates a new scoring config version

docs.title: Task: Save Scoring Weights and Thresholds
docs.text:
1. Open Scoring Weights.
  2. Select a grade in Grade.
  3. Update weights as required.
  4. Confirm total shows Valid at 100.
  5. Set tier thresholds in descending order.
  6. Click Save as New Version.
  7. Result: New scoring config version is saved for that grade.

docs.title: Tab: Subgroup Settings
docs.text: Use this tab to control subgroup inclusion in depth charting.

docs.title: Fields
docs.text:
Include in Depth, required

  • Turn on to include the subgroup in depth charting

Level Weight, required

  • Range: 0.1 to 10
  • Disabled when Include in Depth is off

docs.title: Task: Save Subgroup Settings
docs.text:
1. Open Subgroup Settings.
  2. Set Include in Depth for a subgroup.
  3. Enter Level Weight.
  4. Click Save in that row.
  5. Result: Subgroup setting is saved.

docs.title: Tab: Subjective Metrics
docs.text: Use this tab to manage subjective scoring criteria.

docs.title: Fields
docs.text:
Name, required

  • Metric name must not be blank

Description, optional

  • Clarifies what the metric measures

Weight, required

  • Must be greater than 0

Order, optional

  • Controls display order

docs.title: Task: Add a Metric
docs.text:
1. Open Subjective Metrics.
  2. Enter Name.
  3. Enter optional Description.
  4. Enter Weight and Order.
  5. Click Add Metric.
  6. Result: Metric is added. Update per-grade scoring weights and save new config versions as needed.

docs.title: Task: Add Metric and Update All Grade Configs
docs.text:
1. Fill in the new metric fields.
  2. Click Add, Balance & Save.
  3. Result: Metric is added and all grade configs are updated.

docs.title: Task: Remove a Metric
docs.text:
1. Click the delete button for the metric.
  2. Confirm removal.
  3. Result: Metric is removed from active use.

docs.title: Tab: Tier Names
docs.text: Use this tab to rename tier labels and choose tier colours used across depth pages.

docs.title: Fields
docs.text:
Tier name, required

  • All five tier names must be filled in

Tier colour, required

  • Choose from the provided colour list

docs.title: Task: Save Tier Names
docs.text:
1. Open Tier Names.
  2. Update names and colours.
  3. Click Save Tier Names.
  4. Result: New tier names/colours are applied across depth chart pages.

docs.title: Validation and Rules
docs.text:
• Level weight must be between 0.1 and 10
  • Weight total must equal exactly 100 before saving a config
  • Tier thresholds must be descending (Tier 1 > Tier 2 > Tier 3 > Tier 4)
  • Subjective metric name is required
  • Subjective metric weight must be greater than 0
  • All tier names are required before saving

docs.title: Cannot save scoring config
docs.text:
Symptoms Save fails with a validation message.

How to Fix

  1. Confirm all enabled weight fields total exactly 100.
  2. Confirm thresholds are descending (Tier 1 highest).
  3. Try Balance, then save again.

Common Causes

  • Weight total is not 100
  • Tier thresholds are out of order

docs.title: Cannot save prestige or subgroup weight
docs.text:
Symptoms You see a level weight error.

How to Fix

  1. Enter a value between 0.1 and 10.
  2. Click Save again.

Common Causes

  • Value is below 0.1 or above 10

docs.title: Metric actions fail
docs.text:
Symptoms Metric add/update/remove does not complete.

How to Fix

  1. Check metric Name is filled in.
  2. Ensure Weight is greater than 0.
  3. Retry and refresh the tab.

Common Causes

  • Missing metric name
  • Invalid metric weight

docs.title: Related Pages
docs.text:
• Admin: Depth Charting Overview, view rankings, Career Progression, and historical recalculation
  • Admin: Grade Depth Chart, apply grade-level manual overrides
  • Admin: Score Breakdown, review factor-by-factor scores

How to Access From the sidebar, expand Depth Charting.

docs.title: Exam Management: Create and Manage Exams
docs.text:
Access Level

Trainer or Owner access is required.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Exam Management lets you create exams, configure availability and scoring, add questions, and review completed attempts. You can write questions yourself or, when enabled for your group, generate private AI-assisted drafts from source material.

How to access

Click Learning Management then Exams.

docs.title: Exam List
docs.text:
The exam list shows each exam's name, availability status, pass mark, number of questions presented, time limit, and start and end dates.

Available actions include:

  • Results, shown after users have completed the exam
  • Questions or Add questions
  • Edit
  • Delete
  • Clone, shown after questions have been added

Captured 25 October 2026.

docs.title: Create an Exam
docs.text:
1. Click New exam.
  2. Complete the exam details and settings.
  3. Click Save.
  4. Result: The exam appears in the exam list.

Captured 25 October 2026.

docs.title: Exam Fields
docs.text:
Name, required

  • Enter a short name for the exam.
  • Use letters, numbers, spaces, underscores, full stops, or hyphens.

Questions, required

  • Enter how many questions should be randomly presented from the question pool.
  • Enter 0 to present every question.

Time limit, required

  • Enter the number of minutes allowed.
  • Enter 0 for no time limit.

Pass mark %, required

  • Enter a value from 1 to 100.

Completion required, optional

  • Select this when users must sit the exam before its end date.

Allow resits, optional

  • Select this to let users attempt the exam again after failing.

Notify on completion, optional

  • Select this to email group administrators when a user completes the exam.

Start date, required

  • Sets the first day the exam is available.

End date, required

  • Sets the last day the exam is available.

Exam Description, optional

  • Add instructions or information shown before a user starts the exam.

Exam End Description, optional

  • Add information shown after a user submits the exam.

docs.title: Add a Question Manually
docs.text:
1. Find the exam and click Questions or Add questions.
  2. Click New question.
  3. Enter the question text.
  4. Optionally click Insert image and select an image.
  5. Select Single, Multiple, or True/False.
  6. For Single or Multiple, select the number of answers and enter every answer.
  7. Mark the correct answer or answers.
  8. Click Save.
  9. Result: The question is added to the exam's question pool.

Captured 25 October 2026. The sample question is fictional.

Captured 25 October 2026. The sample answers are fictional.

docs.title: Question Rules
docs.text:
• Question text is required.
  • Every displayed answer field must be completed.
  • A Single question requires one correct answer.
  • A Multiple question requires at least two correct answers.
  • A True/False question requires you to select either True or False as the correct answer.
  • A question with no defined answer displays No answer defined and does not appear in the exam.

docs.title: Use AI Rewrite in Exam Text
docs.text:
When the AI features add-on is active and your role has AI Rewrite access, the purple AI Rewrite button appears in these rich-text fields:

  • Exam Description
  • Exam End Description
  • Question

To use it:

  1. Write the exam instructions or question yourself first.
  2. Select a passage to rewrite only that passage, or leave the text unselected to rewrite the whole field.
  3. Click AI Rewrite.
  4. Check that the rewritten text is accurate, unambiguous, and still tests the intended knowledge.
  5. Edit it where necessary, then save the exam or question normally.

AI Rewrite does not create answer options, choose correct answers, grade attempts, or save the exam. The administrator remains responsible for the question and answer key. See AI Features for access settings, limits, and troubleshooting.

docs.title: Generate Private Question Drafts with AI
docs.text: This feature appears only when AI features and AI exam question drafting are enabled for your group and role.

docs.title: Before You Start
docs.text:
• Prepare the relevant laws, playing conditions, or other authoritative material.
  • You can paste source text, upload PDF, Word, or plain-text documents, or use both.
  • You can upload up to five documents. Each document must be no larger than 10 MB.
  • Keep the page open while the source is read and drafts are generated.
  • AI-generated content may be wrong. A person must verify every question and answer against the source before publication.

docs.title: Generate a Draft Batch
docs.text:
1. Find the exam and click Questions.
  2. Click Generate with AI.
  3. Paste source material into Paste playing conditions or laws, upload documents under Source files, or do both.
  4. In Questions, enter a number from 1 to 20.
  5. Select Mixed, Easy, Medium, or Hard under Difficulty.
  6. Optionally enter a topic in Optional topic or focus.
  7. Select at least one question type: Single answer, Multiple answer, or True/False.
  8. Click Generate private drafts.
  9. Wait for the progress window to close. The review workspace opens when processing finishes.

The system may create fewer questions than requested when the supplied material does not support enough clear, distinct questions.

docs.title: Review an AI Draft
docs.text:
Each draft shows:

  • The question and question type
  • The source used
  • Every answer marked Correct or Incorrect
  • Reviewer reasoning for every answer
  • A source locator and exact supporting excerpt

Reasoning and source evidence are displayed as readable review content. They only become text boxes after you click Edit draft.

docs.title: Verify and Add a Draft to the Exam
docs.text:
1. In Retained sources, expand the source and click open original when available.
  2. Read the cited source at the displayed locator.
  3. Check the question wording.
  4. Check every answer, its Correct or Incorrect marking, and its reasoning.
  5. Check that the exact supporting excerpt supports the entire question.
  6. If everything is accurate, select I checked this question, every option, and the marked answers against the retained source.
  7. Click Verify and add to exam.
  8. Confirm publication.
  9. Result: The draft is added to the exam question pool and marked as published.

Human Verification Is Mandatory

Do not publish from AI output alone. The recorded human check is the final authority for the question and its answers.

docs.title: Edit a Draft
docs.text:
1. Click Edit draft.
  2. Update the question, type, source, answer text, correct-answer markings, reasoning, locator, or supporting excerpt.
  3. Click Save changes.
  4. Review the saved draft again against the retained source.
  5. Complete the verification steps before publishing.

Any edit clears the previous verification. Click Cancel to discard unsaved edits.

docs.title: Regenerate or Reject a Draft
docs.text:
• Click Regenerate and confirm to replace the draft with a new source-grounded suggestion. The replacement must be verified again.
  • Click Reject and confirm when a draft should not be added to the exam.

docs.title: Resume or Delete Drafts
docs.text:
1. Open the exam's question list.
  2. Click Resume AI drafts.
  3. Click Review beside a batch to continue checking it.
  4. Click Delete to remove a batch and its retained private sources.

Deleting a draft batch does not remove questions that were already published to the exam.

docs.title: Edit or Delete an Existing Question
docs.text:
• Click Edit beside a question to change it.
  • Once a user has answered a question, editing is disabled to protect completed attempt records.
  • Click the delete button and confirm to remove a question.

docs.title: Clone an Exam
docs.text:
1. Find an exam that contains questions.
  2. Click the Clone button.
  3. Confirm the action.
  4. Result: A copy of the exam is added to the exam list.

docs.title: Review and Export Results
docs.text:
1. Click Results beside an exam.
  2. Review each user's pass or fail result, mark, correct and incorrect totals, completion time, and attempt count when resits are enabled.
  3. Click View to open an individual attempt.
  4. Click Export Results to download the results for your records.

docs.title: Generate with AI is not visible
docs.text: The group's AI master setting or exam-question drafting setting may be disabled, or the feature may not be available to your role. Ask a group owner to check Admin, Group Settings, Features, then AI features.

docs.title: No drafts were generated
docs.text:
You may see: The supplied material did not support any valid questions. Narrow the source or focus and try another batch.

Try a more specific section of the source, enter a narrower focus, or select question types that suit the material.

docs.title: A source document cannot be processed
docs.text: Check that it is a supported PDF, Word, or plain-text document, is no larger than 10 MB, and contains selectable text. Scanned images without readable text may not produce questions.

docs.title: A draft cannot be published
docs.text: Confirm that you selected the verification statement. If the draft was edited or regenerated, review it again before publishing.

docs.title: An existing question cannot be edited
docs.text: Someone has already answered that question. Create a replacement question instead.

docs.title: Related Pages
docs.text:
• AI Features - Rewrite exam text and configure AI-assisted question drafting
  • Exams - Sit an exam and review your results
  • Group Reporting - Review exam reporting
  • User Management - Manage users who sit exams
  • Group Settings - Configure AI feature access

docs.title: Getting Started: New Organisations
docs.text:
Access Level

Owner access required

Welcome to the Match Official System. This guide walks you through the essential setup steps to get your organisation operational.

docs.title: What You Need to Do First
docs.text: When you first log in as an administrator, you need to configure your group's settings and assessment templates. This typically takes 30-45 minutes and only needs to be done once or as you change your templates to enrich data over site.

docs.title: Step 1: Access Group Settings
docs.text:
1. From the main menu, click Admin
  2. Click Group Settings
  3. You see the Group Settings page with several tabs on the left sidebar

The first section shows your License Information - this tells you how many users and subgroups your organisation is entitled to.

docs.title: Step 2: Set Up Your Organisation Details
docs.text: Captured 25 October 2026.

docs.title: Configure Calendar Start
docs.text:
1. Click the Calendar Start tab
  2. Select the month when your calendar year begins (e.g., July for a football season starting in July)
  3. This month becomes the first month throughout the system

docs.title: Configure Location
docs.text:
1. Click the Location tab
  2. Enter your group's primary location or city
  3. Enter your postcode
  4. Click Save location

Your location is used for weather information and location-based features.

docs.title: Step 3: Configure User Access
docs.text: These settings determine which folders and features are available to users.

docs.title: Enable Folder Access
docs.text:
1. Click the Folder Settings tab
  2. Select Yes for:
    • User folder - Allows each user to have a personal file storage area
    • Subgroups folder - Allows subgroups to have shared file storage areas
  3. Click Save user settings

docs.title: Configure User Response Options
docs.text:
1. Click the User responses tab
  2. Decide which features users can access:
    • Confidential entries (private entries not visible to others)
    • View only entries (shareable but not editable by others)
    • Review requests (ability to request feedback)
  3. Check both Diary and Plan sections
  4. Click Save user settings

docs.title: Set Up Notifications
docs.text:
1. Click the Notifications tab
  2. For each notification type (Diary, Assessment, Plan, Peer), select Yes or No to enable email alerts
  3. Start with Yes for most notifications to keep users informed
  4. Click Save user settings

docs.title: Step 4: Create Subgroups (Optional)
docs.text:
If your organisation has teams, departments, or divisions, create subgroups.

  1. Click the Subgroups tab
  2. For each subgroup, enter the name and click Add subgroup
  3. Common subgroups:
    • Team 1, Team 2, Team 3 (for sports organisations)
    • Department A, Department B (for administrative divisions)
    • Region North, Region South (for geographic divisions)

Each subgroup gets its own folder and can have its own members.

docs.title: Step 5: Add Quick Links (Optional)
docs.text:
Quick links appear on the home page and help users access important resources.

  1. Click the Quick Links tab
  2. Add links for:
    • Your organisation's website
    • Training resources
    • Policies and procedures
    • Contact information
  3. Select an icon for each link
  4. Click Add quick link

docs.title: Step 6: Set Up User Registration (Optional)
docs.text:
If you want new users to register themselves instead of creating accounts manually:

  1. Click the User registration tab
  2. Select Yes
  3. Share the provided registration URL with potential users
  4. New users who register will need to be assigned to subgroups by an administrator

docs.title: Step 7: Configure Assessment Templates
docs.text:
Now that the basic group settings are complete, configure how assessments will work.

Important: Plan Your Templates Carefully

Before you start, plan your templates carefully. Each time you modify a template, the previous version is archived to preserve historical data. Frequent changes can create data inconsistency. Design once, then only modify if absolutely necessary.

  1. From the Admin menu, click Group Settings again
  2. Click the Assessment templates tab
  3. You see two main sections: Assessments and Plans

docs.title: Diary Template
docs.text:
Your users will likely create diary entries most frequently. Configure this first:

Captured 25 October 2026.

  1. Click Diary in the Assessments section
  2. Set Number of days to 3 (most commonly used)
  3. Enable Allow users to request review? - Set to Yes
  4. Enable User can see ratings section? - Set to Yes
  5. Enable User can see comments section? - Set to Yes
  6. For admin visibility, select:
    • Admin ratings: Yes, response shared with user
    • Admin comments: Yes, response shared with user
  7. Enter a User Description explaining how to complete diary entries
  8. Enter an Admin Description with guidance for reviewing
  9. For the 6 detail fields, enter custom fields relevant to your organisation:
    • Detail 1: "Key decisions"
    • Detail 2: "Performance observations"
    • Detail 3: "Areas for improvement"
    • Leave Details 4-6 blank if you don't need them
  10. Remember: Diary entries always include three hardcoded fields: Team A, Team B, and Venue
  11. Click Save assessment design

docs.title: Match Day Template
docs.text:
Configure assessments for specific match/event days:

  1. Click Match Day
  2. Set Number of days to 1
  3. Select Show ratings section? - Choose appropriate visibility
  4. Select Show comments section? - Choose appropriate visibility
  5. Add 6 custom detail fields:
    • Detail 1: "In-game decisions"
    • Detail 2: "Communication"
    • Detail 3: "Positioning"
    • Detail 4: "Positioning"
    • Detail 5: "Player management"
    • Detail 6: "Overall performance"
  6. Remember: Match day entries always include: Team A, Team B, and Venue
  7. Click Save assessment design

docs.title: Other Assessment Types
docs.text:
Configure the remaining types based on your needs:

  • Season: For longer-term reviews (usually just detail fields, no ratings/comments)
  • Media: For video/image assessments
  • Custom: For organisation-specific assessments
  • Peer: For peer-to-peer reviews between officials

For each: 1. Click the type name 2. Add detail fields relevant to your organisation 3. Configure ratings and comments visibility 4. Click Save assessment design

docs.title: Step 8: Set Up Rating Scales
docs.text:
1. Still in Assessment Templates, click the Ratings tab
  2. Add rating options users will see. For example:
    • "Excellent - Far exceeds expectations"
    • "Good - Meets expectations"
    • "Needs improvement - Below expectations"
    • "Not assessed"
  3. For each, click Add rating

These ratings appear in all assessment forms.

docs.title: Step 9: Create Competitions (Optional)
docs.text:
If you want to track specific competitions or events:

  1. Click the Competitions tab
  2. Enter competition or event names
  3. Click Add competition

Examples: - "Premier League" - "Cup Competition" - "Tournament" - "Friendly"

docs.title: Step 10: Customise Ratings and Comments (Advanced)
docs.text:
For more advanced configuration, you can customise rating and comment fields per assessment type:

  1. Go to each assessment type (Diary, Match Day, etc.)
  2. Scroll to see rating options (Rating 1 through Rating 20)
  3. Enter custom rating labels specific to your organisation
  4. Below that, enter comment field labels (Comment 1 through Comment 10)
  5. Click Save assessment design

docs.title: For a Football Association
docs.text:
Group Settings

  • Calendar Start: January
  • Location: headquarters city
  • User folder: Yes
  • Subgroups folder: Yes
  • Create subgroups: Referees, Assistants, Video Assistants
  • Notifications: enable Match/Assessment and Review alerts as needed

Assessment Templates

  • Diary: Number of days = 1; full ratings and comments enabled; allow review requests
  • Match Day: Number of days = 1;
  • Peer: Number of days = 1; peer ratings enabled (confidential option available)
  • Media: enable for video/image attachments where required

Detail fields (examples)

  • Decision making
  • Positioning
  • Communication
  • Game awareness

Ratings

  • Excellent — Exceeds expectations
  • Good — Meets expectations
  • Satisfactory — Meets basic expectations
  • Needs improvement — Below expectations

Suggested defaults

  1. Diary: 1 day; allow review requests; user and admin ratings + comments visible
  2. Match Day: 1 day; include hardcoded fields; media uploads optional
  3. Peer: peer ratings enabled; confidentiality option on request

docs.title: For a Cricket Association
docs.text:
Group Settings

  • Calendar Start: April
  • Location: county or club headquarters
  • User folder: Yes
  • Subgroups folder: Yes
  • Create subgroups: Umpires, Scorers, Coaches, Squad panels
  • Notifications: enable Match/Assessment and Review alerts

Assessment Templates

  • Diary: Number of days = 2; ratings and comments enabled
  • Match Day: Number of days = 1;
  • Peer: Number of days = 2; peer feedback enabled
  • Media: for video/image reviews and timestamped comments
  • Season: end‑of‑season summary reviews
  • Custom: fitness and technical skills assessments

Detail fields (examples)

  • Decision making
  • Positioning & movement
  • Communication
  • Playing conditions
  • Match management
  • Teamwork
  • Use of technology (e.g., DRS/video)

Ratings

  • Excellent — Far exceeds expectations
  • Good — Meets expectations
  • Satisfactory — Acceptable standard
  • Needs improvement — Below expectations
  • Not assessed

Suggested defaults

  1. Diary: 1 day; allow review requests; user/admin ratings and comments visible
  2. Match Day: 1 day; include the three hardcoded fields; enable media uploads and time‑coded comments
  3. Peer: peer ratings enabled with confidential option
  4. Media: allow reviewers to timestamp clips and leave time‑coded comments

docs.title: For a Sports Development Programme
docs.text:
Group Settings

  • Calendar Start: September
  • Location: facility location
  • User folder: Yes
  • Subgroups folder: Yes
  • Create subgroups: Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced
  • Notifications: enable training and progress alerts

Assessment Templates

  • Diary: Number of days = 2; comments only for reflective learning
  • Custom: development progress tracking
  • Season: end‑of‑season reviews

Detail fields (examples)

  • Fitness level
  • Tactical understanding

docs.title: For a High Performance Programme
docs.text:
Group Settings

  • Calendar Start: January
  • Location: performance centre or headquarters
  • User folder: Yes
  • Subgroups folder: Yes
  • Create subgroups: Department A, Department B (or by sport/discipline)
  • Notifications: all enabled (daily/weekly summaries)

Assessment Templates

  • Diary: Number of days = 1; comments only for rapid feedback
  • Season: quarterly reviews (summary and trends)
  • Custom: training module and competency assessments
  • Media: support for technical video review

Detail fields (examples)

  • Learning outcomes
  • Competency demonstrated
  • Areas for development
  • Next steps
  • Fitness and recovery metrics

Suggested defaults

  2. Season: quarterly cadence with trend reporting
  3. Custom: align templates to training modules and competency frameworks

These examples are practical starting points — tailor fields, visibility and notification settings to match your organisation's workflows and governance.

docs.title: What to Do After Setup
docs.text:
Once you've completed these setup steps:

  1. Add users to your group (see User Management)
  2. Assign users to subgroups if you created them
  3. Share the registration link with potential users (if registration is enabled)
  4. Test a sample entry by creating a diary or assessment yourself
  5. Communicate settings to users so they know what to expect

docs.title: How long does setup take?
docs.text: Most organisations complete setup in 30-45 minutes on the first attempt. You can always adjust settings later.

docs.title: Can I change settings after setup?
docs.text: Yes. All settings can be modified at any time. Changes to templates only apply to new assessments created after the change.

docs.title: Do existing entries change if I modify a template?
docs.text: No. Existing assessments keep their original format. Only new assessments use the updated template.

docs.title: What should I do if I'm not sure about a setting?
docs.text: Start with the recommended defaults and adjust later based on user feedback. Settings can be changed anytime without affecting existing data.

docs.title: Who can see the entries users create?
docs.text: That depends on your response settings. By default: - Users can make entries confidential (private) - Admins can see all entries - Reviewers can only see entries assigned to them - Users can request reviews

docs.title: Getting Help
docs.text:
If you need assistance:

  1. Check the detailed guides linked above
  2. Review the troubleshooting sections in each guide
  3. Contact Cortana Design support for technical issues

docs.title: Group Settings
docs.text:
Access Level

Owner access required

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Group Settings allows administrators to manage how your organisation operates within the Match Official System. You can control user registration, calendar dates, folder access, notification settings, and how users interact with assessments and plans.

docs.title: How to Access
docs.text: From the Owner Admin menu, expand Group Management and click Group settings.

docs.title: Before You Start
docs.text:
• You must be an administrator with the correct access level
  • Changes to group settings affect all users in your group
  • Some settings are destructive (such as folder deletion) and cannot be easily undone
  • Your group's licence information is displayed at the top of the page

docs.title: Major Settings
docs.text: Captured 25 October 2026.

docs.title: Subgroups
docs.text:
Subgroups allow you to organise users within your group. Users can be assigned to one or more subgroups for filtering, reporting, and targeted communications.

View and manage existing subgroups:

  1. Navigate to Group Settings
  2. Click the Subgroups tab
  3. You see a list of all subgroups in your group
  4. For each subgroup, you can:
    • Click Edit to rename it
    • Click Delete to remove it (the subgroup folder will be deleted)
    • Click Recreate Folder to restore a missing folder (if folder viewing is enabled)

Add a new subgroup:

  1. In the Subgroups section, enter the subgroup name in the text field
  2. Click Add subgroup
  3. A new subgroup is created with its own folder
  4. You can now add users to this subgroup

Note

The number of subgroups you can create depends on your licence.

docs.title: Group Logo
docs.text:
Upload a logo image to represent your organisation in MOS.

  1. In the Major Settings section, click the Logo tab
  2. If a logo is already uploaded, a preview is shown
  3. Click Choose file and select a PNG or JPG image (maximum 2MB)
  4. Click Upload logo
  5. The logo is saved and displayed for your group

docs.title: Theme
docs.text:
Select a colour theme for your group. This affects the appearance of the system for all users in your group, unless they choose their own theme in their profile settings.

Change the group theme:

  1. In the Major Settings section, click the Theme tab
  2. Click on a theme image to select it
  3. The system reloads and applies your new theme immediately
  4. All users in your group see the new theme

Requesting a new theme is possible by contacting Cortana Design.

Captured 25 October 2026.

docs.title: User Registration
docs.text:
Control whether new users can self-register for your group. When enabled, users can request access via a registration link.

Enable or disable user registration:

  1. Click the User registration tab
  2. Select Yes to allow registration or No to disable it
  3. If enabled, you see a registration URL that you can share with potential users
  4. New users who register will have group-level access (administrators must assign them to subgroups afterwards)

docs.title: Calendar Start
docs.text:
Set when your group's calendar year begins. This affects seasonal reporting and date filtering throughout the system.

Change the calendar start month:

  1. Click the Calendar Start tab
  2. Select your preferred starting month from the dropdown
  3. The selected month is now the first month of your calendar year throughout the system

docs.title: Location
docs.text:
Set your group's default location for weather information and other location-based features.

Save location details:

  1. Click the Location tab
  2. Enter your group's location (town/city)
  3. Enter your postcode
  4. Click Save location
  5. Result: These details are stored and used for location-based features

docs.title: Quick Links
docs.text:
Manage the shortcut links displayed on the home page for your group. These provide quick access to frequently used external resources.

View quick links:

  1. Click the Quick Links tab
  2. You see a table of all links currently displayed

Add a new quick link:

  1. In the Quick Links section, enter:
    • Link title: The text users see
    • Link url: The full web address (e.g., https://example.com)
    • Icon: Select an icon from the dropdown (optional)
  2. Click Add quick link
  3. The link is added to the home page immediately

Edit a quick link:

  1. Click Edit next to the link
  2. Update the title, URL, or icon
  3. Click Update

Delete a quick link:

  1. Click Delete next to the link
  2. The link is removed from the home page

docs.title: Member Profile Fields
docs.text:
Define custom profile fields that your members must complete. These allow you to collect additional information beyond standard fields, such as emergency contact details, working with children checks, or specific job categories.

What You Can Collect

Financial and authentication data (credit cards, bank account numbers, passwords) cannot be collected. The system blocks sensitive data patterns.

View existing member fields:

  1. Click the Member Fields tab in Group Settings
  2. You see a table of all fields currently defined for your group
  3. For each field, you see:
    • Label — The field name displayed to members
    • Type — Text, number, date, long text, dropdown, or checkbox
    • Category — The information category (personal, employment, medical, etc.)
    • Required — Whether members must complete this field
    • Active — Whether the field is currently visible to members

Captured 25 October 2026.

Add a new member field:

  1. Click the Member Fields tab
  2. Scroll to the Add a new member field section
  3. Enter:
    • Field label — What to call the field (e.g., "Working with Children Check")
    • Type — Choose from: Text, Number, Date, Long text, Dropdown, Checkbox
    • Category — Choose from: Personal, Emergency Contact, Identification, Employment, Medical, Other
    • Sort order — Number controlling display order (0 = first, higher numbers appear lower)
  4. Check Required if members must complete this field
  5. If type is Dropdown, enter options as a JSON array (e.g., ["Option A","Option B"])
  6. Click Add field
  7. Confirmation: "Field added"

Edit an existing member field:

  1. In the Member Fields table, click Edit next to the field you want to change
  2. Update:
    • Label
    • Type
    • Category
    • Sort order
    • Required status
    • Active status (uncheck to hide from members without deleting data)
    • Dropdown options (if applicable)
  3. Click Save
  4. Confirmation: "Field updated"

Delete a member field:

  1. Click Delete next to the field
  2. Warning message: "Deleting this field will also remove all member values for it. This cannot be undone."
  3. Click confirmation to delete
  4. Confirmation: "Field deleted"
  5. All values members entered for this field are permanently removed

Export member field data as CSV:

  1. In the Member Fields tab, click Export member data as CSV
  2. A file downloads containing:
    • One row per member
    • Columns for each active field
    • Member name and email
    • All responses to custom fields
  3. Use this for reporting, planning, or integration with other systems

docs.title: Field Type Reference
docs.text:
Text

  • Single line of text
  • Examples: name, check number, license plate
  • Members type freely

Number

  • Numeric values only
  • Examples: years of experience, staff ID
  • No special characters allowed

Date

  • Calendar date picker
  • Format: automatically formatted for your region
  • Examples: date of birth, expiry date

Long text

  • Multiple lines of text
  • Examples: medical conditions, allergies, notes
  • Allows free-form paragraphs

Dropdown

  • Fixed list of options
  • Members choose one from the list
  • You provide options when creating the field
  • Examples: position type, status, shift preference

Checkbox

  • Boolean (yes/no or confirmed)
  • Members check the box if applicable
  • Examples: "I agree to...", "I have completed..."

docs.title: Field Categories
docs.text:
Choose a category that accurately describes the information type. Categories help you and members understand what the field is for, and the system blocks sensitive categories:

  • Personal — General personal details (age, preferences, interests)
  • Emergency Contact — Next of kin, emergency contact name and number
  • Identification — Government-issued IDs, working with children checks, licenses
  • Employment — Job role, employer, department, qualifications
  • Medical — Allergies, medical conditions, blood type, medications
  • Other — Miscellaneous non-sensitive fields

Blocked Categories

Financial information (bank accounts, card numbers) and authentication data (passwords) cannot be collected. The system automatically detects and blocks these patterns.

docs.title: Member Experience
docs.text:
When members log in, they see:

  • Group Info tab appears on their profile page (only if you've defined fields)
  • A form with all active fields your group has created
  • Required fields marked with a red asterisk (*)
  • Appropriate input controls for each field type
  • Save button to submit responses

Members can update their responses at any time unless you deactivate the field.

docs.title: Common Field Examples
docs.text:
Uniform/Sizing:

  • Field: "Shirt Size", Type: Dropdown, Category: Personal
  • Options: ["XS","S","M","L","XL","2XL","3XL"]

Emergency Contact:

  • Field: "Emergency Contact Name", Type: Text, Category: Emergency Contact, Required: Yes
  • Field: "Emergency Contact Number", Type: Text, Category: Emergency Contact, Required: Yes

Safety Checks:

  • Field: "Working with Children Check Number", Type: Text, Category: Identification
  • Field: "Check Expiry Date", Type: Date, Category: Identification

Employment:

  • Field: "Job Title", Type: Dropdown, Category: Employment
  • Options: ["Head Coach","Assistant Coach","Club Official","Volunteer"]

Medical:

  • Field: "Medical Conditions", Type: Long text, Category: Medical
  • Field: "Allergies", Type: Long text, Category: Medical

docs.title: User Access and Actions
docs.text: These settings control what features users can access and what actions they can perform.

docs.title: Folder Settings
docs.text:
Control which file storage folders are available for your group. Disabling a folder will permanently delete all files within it.

Enable or disable folders:

  1. Click the Folder Settings tab
  2. For User folder: Select Yes to enable or No to disable
  3. For Subgroups folder: Select Yes to enable or No to disable
  4. Click Save user settings at the bottom of the page

Warning

Setting a folder to 'No' will delete the folder and all its contents. This is a destructive operation and data cannot be recovered.

docs.title: Modules
docs.text:
Enable or disable specific features for users in your group.

Enable or disable peer assessments:

  1. Click the Modules tab
  2. Select Yes to allow peer assessments or No to disable them
  3. Click Save user settings

Enable or disable user search:

  1. In the Modules section, select Yes to allow users to search profile information or No to disable it
  2. Click Save user settings

Enable or disable voice dictation:

  1. In the Modules tab, switch Enable voice dictation in diary and review editors? on or off.
  2. Click Save settings.
  3. Result: Settings saved successfully. After users next open or reload an affected page, supported browsers show a microphone button in diary and peer-review comment fields, administrator review comment fields, and assessment feedback.

Voice dictation is enabled by default and can be disabled by an Owner. It uses the browser's speech-recognition service and does not require the AI features add-on. Users must grant microphone permission before dictation can begin. MOS inserts the text returned by the browser; the browser or its speech provider may process the audio to produce that text.

See Assessments and Reviews for member instructions and Admin: View Assessments and Plans for reviewer instructions.

docs.title: AI Feature Access
docs.text:
The AI features section appears in the settings table when the AI features add-on is active for your group. It controls which roles can use each AI-assisted capability.

  1. Find the AI features section.
  2. Set Rewrite available to to Owners only, Owners, Viewers & Reviewers, or Everyone.
  3. Set Breakdown Summary available to to Owners only or Owners & Selectors.
  4. Set Review Context available to to Owners only, Owners & Viewers, or Owners, Viewers & Reviewers.
  5. Set Season Review Summary available to to Owners only or Owners & Viewers.
  6. Set Trainer available to to Owners only, Owners, Viewers, Reviewers & Trainers, or Everyone.
  7. Set AI exam question drafting available to to Owners only or Owners & Trainers.
  8. Click Save settings.
  9. Result: The selected roles can see the corresponding AI controls in their normal workflows.

If this section is missing, check the AI Enabled badge near the licence information and confirm the add-on on the Billing page.

See AI Features for what each capability does and where users encounter it.

docs.title: User Responses
docs.text:
Set how users can submit diary and plan entries, including confidentiality and review options.

Diary entries - Allow users to:

  1. Click the User responses tab
  2. Make entries confidential: Select Yes or No
  3. Make entries view only: Select Yes or No
  4. Request a review: Select Yes or No

Plan entries - Allow users to:

  1. Make entries confidential: Select Yes or No
  2. Make entries view only: Select Yes or No
  3. Request a review: Select Yes or No

Assessment feedback - Allow users to:

  1. Submit feedback on assessments: Select Yes or No
    • When enabled, users can provide a one-time feedback response after viewing an assessment
  2. Click Save user settings

docs.title: Notifications
docs.text:
Configure automatic email notifications for various activities.

Diary notification settings:

  1. Click the Notifications tab
  2. Under "Notifications for diary entries", choose Yes or No for:
    • Notify reviewers of new review requests
    • Notify user when reviewed
    • Notify reviewer when unread entry is seen by user
  3. Click Save user settings

Assessment notification settings:

  1. Under "Notifications for assessment entries", choose Yes or No for:
    • Notify user when new assessment is assigned
    • Notify reviewer when assessment is seen by user
    • Notify reviewer when user submits feedback on an assessment
  2. Click Save user settings

Plan notification settings:

  1. Under "Notifications for plan entries", choose Yes or No for:
    • Notify reviewers of new review requests
    • Notify user when reviewed
    • Notify reviewer when entry isings**

Peer review notification settings:

  1. Under "Notifications for peer review entries", choose Yes or No for:
    • Notify user of review
    • Notify admin(s) of review
    • Notify reviewee when review seen
    • Notify admin(s) when review seen
  2. Click Save user settings

docs.title: Define a custom member profile field
docs.text:
1. Navigate to Group Settings
  2. Click the Member Fields tab
  3. Scroll to Add a new member field
  4. Enter a field label (e.g., "Emergency Contact Phone")
  5. Select the field type
  6. Choose a category
  7. Set the sort order number
  8. Check Required if members must complete it
  9. Click Add field
  10. Members see the new field in their Group Info tab

docs.title: Create a dropdown field with options
docs.text:
1. Go to Group Settings and click Member Fields
  2. In the Add field section, select Dropdown as the type
  3. In the Dropdown options field, enter JSON format options
  4. Example: ["Morning","Afternoon","Evening"]
  5. Each option must be in quotes, separated by commas, inside brackets
  6. Click Add field

docs.title: Hide a member field without deleting data
docs.text:
1. Click Member Fields tab
  2. Click Edit next to the field
  3. Uncheck the Active checkbox
  4. Click Save
  5. The field is hidden from members but all their data is preserved
  6. You can reactivate it later

docs.title: Export all member profile data
docs.text:
1. Click Member Fields tab
  2. Click Export member data as CSV
  3. A file downloads with all member responses to custom fields
  4. Open in Excel or your spreadsheet application
  5. Use for reporting, planning, or to integrate with other systems

docs.title: Change the order fields appear to members
docs.text:
1. Click Member Fields tab
  2. For each field, click Edit
  3. Change the Sort order number (lower numbers appear first)
  4. Click Save
  5. Fields are instantly reordered on members' profiles

docs.title: Make a field required
docs.text:
1. Click Member Fields tab
  2. Click Edit next to the field
  3. Check the Required checkbox
  4. Click Save
  5. Members cannot save their profile without completing this field
  6. A red asterisk (*) appears next to required fields

docs.title: Create a new subgroup
docs.text:
1. Navigate to Group Settings
  2. In the Subgroups section, enter a name for your new subgroup
  3. Click Add subgroup
  4. The subgroup is created with its own folder
  5. Add users to the subgroup through the Membership section

docs.title: Change your group's theme
docs.text:
1. Go to Group Settings
  2. Click the Theme tab
  3. Click on the theme image you want to use
  4. The page reloads with the new theme applied

docs.title: Enable user registration for your group
docs.text:
1. Go to Group Settings
  2. Click the User registration tab
  3. Select Yes
  4. Share the registration URL with potential users
  5. New users can register themselves

docs.title: Set when your calendar year starts
docs.text:
1. Go to Group Settings
  2. Click the Calendar Start tab
  3. Select the month your calendar year begins
  4. All dates throughout the system reflect this starting month

docs.title: Add multiple quick links
docs.text:
1. Go to Group Settings
  2. Click the Quick Links tab
  3. Add the first link: enter title, URL, and icon, then click Add quick link
  4. Add the second link: repeat the process
  5. Continue for each link
  6. All links appear on the home page in order

docs.title: Restrict folder access
docs.text:
1. Go to Group Settings
  2. Click the Folder Settings tab
  3. Select No for User folder or Subgroups folder (or both)
  4. Click Save user settings
  5. Users no longer see or access that folder

Warning

Folders will be deleted along with all their contents.

docs.title: Settings not saving
docs.text:
Symptoms

  • You click Save but the settings don't change
  • Error message appears

How to fix

  1. Check that you have administrator access
  2. Verify all required fields are completed
  3. Try saving again
  4. If the problem continues, contact your system administrator

Common causes

  • Insufficient access permissions
  • Missing or invalid information in fields
  • Browser cache issues

docs.title: Member field not appearing to users
docs.text:
Symptoms

  • You created a field but members don't see it
  • The field was active but disappeared

How to fix

  1. Go to Group Settings and click Member Fields
  2. Verify the field is in the table with Active status
  3. Check the field isn't marked as inactive (broken eye icon)
  4. Ask the member to:
    • Refresh their browser
    • Log out and log back in
    • Clear their browser cache
  5. If the field still doesn't appear, try editing and saving it again

Common causes

  • Field is marked as inactive
  • Browser cache preventing display
  • Member hasn't refreshed their profile page

docs.title: Group Info tab not visible to members
docs.text:
Symptoms

  • Members don't see the Group Info tab on their profile
  • You've created fields but they won't appear

How to fix

  1. Click Member Fields in Group Settings
  2. Check your Member Fields table
  3. Verify you have at least one field that is Active
  4. If fields exist and are active, ask members to:
    • Refresh the page (Ctrl+R or Cmd+R)
    • Clear browser cache
    • Log out and back in
  5. If nothing appears, all your fields may be inactive

docs.title: Fields saved but member responses are blank
docs.text:
Symptoms

  • Fields appear but show empty values
  • Members report they entered information but it's not saved

How to fix

  1. Check if the field is marked as Required
  2. Ask members to click Save after entering data
  3. Verify the field exists and is active
  4. If a required field is empty, members cannot save their profile — this is intentional
  5. Check the field type matches what you intended (dropdown vs text, etc.)

docs.title: Can't delete a field because data exists
docs.text:
Symptoms

  • You click Delete on a field
  • Warning message shows data will be lost

How to fix

  1. If you want to keep the data, click Cancel
  2. Instead, click Edit and uncheck Active to hide the field
  3. If you definitely want to delete the field and its data, click the confirmation
  4. Warning: This is permanent and cannot be undone

Alternative: Export the member field data to CSV before deleting, so you have a backup.

docs.title: Dropdown field showing invalid options
docs.text:
Symptoms

  • Members see garbled or broken options in a dropdown
  • Options don't display correctly

How to fix

  1. Click Member Fields and find the dropdown field
  2. Click Edit
  3. Check the Dropdown options field in JSON format
  4. Ensure:
    • Options are in quotes: "Option"
    • Separated by commas: "Option A","Option B"
    • Wrapped in brackets: ["Option A","Option B"]
  5. Click Save
  6. Ask members to refresh their page

Example correct format:

["XS","S","M","L","XL","2XL"]

docs.title: Members report validation error for sensitive data
docs.text:
Symptoms

  • Members trying to enter information get an error
  • Error mentions "financial" or "sensitive data"

This is intentional — the system protects sensitive information:

  • Financial data (credit cards, bank account numbers, IBANs, BSB numbers)
  • Authentication data (passwords)

What to do:

  1. Don't collect this information via profile fields
  2. Choose a different field category if safe (e.g., use "Identification" for driver's license numbers, not "Financial")
  3. Use a different secure system for truly sensitive data
  4. If unsure if something should be collected, contact your system administrator

docs.title: Quick links not appearing on home page
docs.text:
Symptoms

  • You added a quick link but don't see it
  • Links appear for some users but not others

How to fix

  1. Go back to Group Settings
  2. Click the Quick Links tab
  3. Verify the link was created (it should appear in the table)
  4. Check that the URL is valid and starts with http:// or https://
  5. Clear your browser cache and refresh the page

Common causes

  • URL format is incorrect
  • Browser cache preventing display of new link
  • User permissions preventing access

docs.title: Folder is missing
docs.text:
Symptoms

  • A subgroup folder is marked as missing
  • Users cannot access the folder

How to fix

  1. Go to Group Settings
  2. In the Subgroups section, click Recreate Folder next to the missing subgroup
  3. The folder is recreated
  4. Users can now access it again

Note: Folder recreation is only available if folder viewing is enabled in Folder Settings.

docs.title: Admin: Membership and Roles
docs.text:
Owner access required

Only users with Owner access can manage membership and roles.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
The Membership and Roles page lets you manage who belongs to your group and what they can do. You can assign access levels, grant specific roles, and organise users into subgroups.

How to access: From the main menu, select Admin then Membership and Roles.

docs.title: Understanding Access Levels and Roles
docs.text:
The system uses two components to control permissions:

Access Level (choose one):

  • User: Standard member with personal workspace access
  • Owner: Full administrative control of the group

Roles (choose any combination):

  • Viewer: Can create assessments on other users
  • Reviewer: Can review diary and plan entries, and run reports
  • Trainer: Can manage exams (group-level only)
  • Communications: Can manage news articles (group-level only)
  • Files Manager: Can upload, delete, and organise files and folders
  • Appointer: Can manage appointments and availability
  • Selector: Can access depth charting

A member can have multiple roles. For example, a coach might have both Viewer and Reviewer roles.

For detailed information about what each role can do, see Levels of Access.

docs.title: Finding Members
docs.text: Captured 25 October 2026.

docs.title: Search by name
docs.text:
1. Type a name in the search box
  2. Click Search or press Enter
  3. Matching members appear in the list

docs.title: Filter by role
docs.text:
Captured 25 October 2026.

  1. Click the Filter dropdown
  2. Select one or more access levels or roles to filter by
  3. Click Apply
  4. Only members with the selected roles appear

To clear filters, click Clear in the filter dropdown.

docs.title: Add a member to your group
docs.text: To add an existing user to your group, open Admin > User Management, find the person and click Edit user. In Group Membership, turn on the Member switch for your group. The change is saved immediately.

docs.title: Add a member to a subgroup
docs.text:
1. Find the subgroup on the Membership and Roles page
  2. Click Add Member on that subgroup's row
  3. Search for and select the user
  4. Choose the access level and any available roles
  5. Click Add Member
  6. Result: MOS confirms the addition and refreshes the membership list

Captured 25 October 2026.

Tip

Start with the minimum roles needed. You can add more later if required.

docs.title: Editing a Member
docs.text:
Captured 25 October 2026.

Change a member's access level or roles.

  1. Find the member in the list
  2. Click the Edit button (pencil icon)
  3. Change the Access Level if needed
  4. Tick or untick Roles as required
  5. Click Save Changes

Changes take effect immediately.

docs.title: What happens when you change roles
docs.text:
• Adding a role: The member gains access to that feature immediately
  • Removing a role: The member loses access to that feature immediately
  • Changing to Owner: The member gains full administrative access
  • Changing from Owner to User: The member loses administrative access but keeps any assigned roles

docs.title: Removing a Member
docs.text:
Remove a member from your group.

  1. Find the member in the list
  2. Click the Remove button
  3. Confirm the removal

Removing a member:

  • Removes them from the group only
  • Does not delete their account from the system
  • Does not affect their membership in other groups
  • Can be reversed by adding them again

docs.title: Working with Subgroups
docs.text: Subgroups help organise members into teams, regions, or divisions.

docs.title: Viewing subgroup members
docs.text:
• Click on a subgroup name to expand it
  • Use Expand All to see all subgroups at once
  • Use Collapse All to close all subgroups

docs.title: Adding members to a subgroup
docs.text:
1. Expand the subgroup
  2. Click Add Member within that subgroup
  3. Follow the standard add member process

Members can belong to multiple subgroups.

docs.title: Subgroup-level roles
docs.text:
Some roles work differently at the subgroup level:

  • Viewer, Reviewer, Files Manager, Appointer and Selector can be assigned at subgroup level
  • Owner, Trainer and Communications are group-level only and are not available for subgroups

For more details about subgroup permissions, see Subgroup Membership.

docs.title: Role Badges
docs.text:
The member list shows each person's access level and assigned roles as badges. A member can have multiple role badges.

Captured 25 October 2026.

docs.title: User not found when adding
docs.text: The person may not have an account in the system yet. They need to register first, or you can create an account for them in User Management.

docs.title: Cannot assign certain roles
docs.text: Some roles (Trainer, Communications) are only available at the group level, not subgroup level. If you are editing a subgroup membership, these options will not appear.

docs.title: Member cannot access expected features
docs.text:
Check that:

  1. They have the correct role assigned
  2. They are in the correct subgroup (if features are subgroup-specific)
  3. They have logged out and back in (some permission changes require a fresh login)

docs.title: Duplicate member entries
docs.text: If someone appears twice, remove the duplicate entry and keep a single membership record with the correct roles.

docs.title: Tips
docs.text:
• Apply the principle of least privilege - give only the roles needed
  • Review role assignments regularly, especially for Reviewer and Owner
  • Use subgroups to organise members and control visibility
  • Document role assignments for compliance if required

docs.title: Related Pages
docs.text:
• Levels of Access: Detailed explanation of each role
  • User Management: Creating and managing user accounts
  • Subgroup Membership: How subgroups affect permissions
  • Group Settings: Configure group options

docs.title: News Management
docs.text:
Access Level

Communications or Owner access required

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Create and manage news articles for your association. You can publish articles to all members or target specific subgroups, optionally send email notifications, and use Email-to-News to create articles with attachments when that option is available for your group.

docs.title: How to Access
docs.text:
1. Click Admin
  2. Select News Management
  3. Result: The News Management page opens showing all existing articles

Captured 25 October 2026.

docs.title: How to Create an Article
docs.text:
1. Navigate to Admin then News Management
  2. Click New News
  3. Enter a Title for the article
  4. Select your Audience:
    • Select All Users to reach all members in your association
    • Select a subgroup name to reach only members of that group
  5. Choose if you want to send a notification email:
    • Select Yes to email all members in the audience
    • Select No to skip email notification
