  3. Open it to see your colleague's feedback
  4. Mark as read to acknowledge you have reviewed it
  5. Your colleague's name is shown as the reviewer

docs.title: View a Review or Assessment
docs.text:
1. Open an item from My Assessments.
  2. Review original notes (Diary/Plan) and any reviewer ratings/comments.
  3. If media is included, download the file or open its link. FrogBox channels show Watch on FrogBox (sign-in may be required). Play Cricket links show Open Play Cricket scorecard or, when a stream is available, Watch on Play Cricket. Other links may open YouTube, Dropbox, OneDrive, or another external service.
  4. If prompted, marking it as viewed acknowledges that you have read the review.

Result: The item’s state updates accordingly and may notify your reviewer (where enabled).

docs.title: Submit Feedback on an Assessment
docs.text: After viewing a completed assessment, you may be able to submit feedback to the reviewer (if your group has enabled this feature).

docs.title: When You Can Submit Feedback
docs.text:
• The assessment must be in Reviewed status (completed by the reviewer)
  • Your group must have assessment feedback enabled
  • You can only submit feedback once per assessment
  • Once submitted, feedback cannot be edited or deleted

docs.title: How to Submit Feedback
docs.text:
1. Open the assessment from your My Assessments list
  2. Scroll to the Your Feedback section (appears near the bottom)
  3. Enter your feedback in the text field
  4. Your feedback can be up to 4000 characters
  5. Click Submit Feedback

Result: The feedback appears with a submitted date. The reviewer receives a notification (if enabled).

docs.title: If You Cannot See the Feedback Section
docs.text:
• Your group may not have feedback enabled — contact your administrator
  • You may have already submitted feedback on this assessment (only one submission allowed)
  • The assessment may not be in completed status yet

docs.title: Export My Data
docs.text:
Download your lists to CSV for your records.

  • Export assessments: Downloads your assessments list.
  • Export plans: Downloads your plans list.

Tip

For larger exports or admin-level raw data, see Group Reporting.

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text:
• Bulk action skipped: The item’s current state may not allow that action.
  • Media link not working: Try again on a stable connection; some links open in external services.
  • FrogBox asks you to sign in: Sign in to FrogBox if you have access to the club channel, or ask the person who shared the review for help.
  • A Play Cricket link opens a scorecard: The review may link to the public scorecard rather than a live stream.
  • Can’t find my item: Clear filters, check paging, or widen your date range where available.

docs.title: Voice dictation is unavailable or stops
docs.text:
• The microphone button is missing: Ask an Owner to check the voice-dictation setting, then try the latest Chrome or Edge.
  • “Microphone access was blocked. Allow microphone access in your browser and try again.”: Allow microphone access for MOS in your browser settings, then try again.
  • “No working microphone was found.”: Connect or enable a microphone and check that another application is not preventing access.
  • “Speech recognition could not connect. Check your connection and try again.”: Check your internet connection, then restart dictation.
  • “No speech was detected. Try again when you are ready.”: Move closer to the microphone and restart dictation when ready to speak.
  • “Dictation stopped unexpectedly. Please try again.” or “Dictation could not start. Please try again.”: Stop dictation, refresh the page, and try again. If the problem continues, use the latest Chrome or Edge.

docs.title: Response States (Assessments & Diary Entries)
docs.text:
Your assessments and diary entries move through different states as they're created, reviewed, and published. Each state controls what you can do with the entry.

State Colour Meaning What You Can Do Confidential Your private draft, not sent for review Edit, delete, submit for review Awaiting Review You submitted it, waiting for admin feedback View only, cannot edit Reviewed Admin published feedback for you to read View, mark as read, revert to confidential (if allowed in group settings) View Only Shared for reading (no feedback included) View, mark as read, revert to confidential (if allowed in group settings) Assessment Assigned to you by an admin View only, cannot delete (can submit feedback response if enabled) Assessment Replied You have submitted feedback on the assessment View only, cannot edit your feedback Draft Assessment Assessment saved as draft (not yet published) View, cannot edit or delete

docs.title: Response States (Plans)
docs.text:
Plans follow a similar but slightly different flow:

State Colour Meaning What You Can Do Confidential Your private plan, not shared Edit, delete, submit for review Awaiting Review Submitted to reviewer, waiting for feedback View only, cannot edit Reviewed Reviewer published feedback View, mark as read, archive, revert to confidential View Only Shared for reading only View, mark as read, archive

  A_Await --> A_Reviewed: Reviewer publishes

  A_Reviewed --> A_Conf: Revert to confidential (when allowed)
  A_Reviewed --> A_Archived: Admin archive

  note right of A_Reviewed: First open marks Seen. Some items are assigned and cannot be deleted

docs.title: Sequence: Create diary entry and review cycle
docs.text:
Hold "Alt" / "Option" to enable pan & zoom 
sequenceDiagram
  participant U as User
  participant S as System
  participant A as Admin/Reviewer

  U->>S: New Diary (enter details)
  U->>S: Submit for review (Awaiting review)
  A->>S: Complete ratings/comments
  A->>S: Publish (Reviewed)
  S-->>U: Optional email/notification
  U->>S: Open item (first time)
  Note over U,S: First open marks Seen
  U->>S: (Optional) Revert to confidential or Archive (plans)

docs.text: If you are an administrator or reviewer responsible for managing, reassigning, or reviewing assessments and plans, see Admin: View Assessments and Plans for detailed management instructions.

docs.title: Forgot Password: Recover Your Account
docs.text:
Access Level

Public (before authentication)

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
If you forget your password, you can request a reset using the email address registered to your MOS account and the secret question saved for that account. Accounts that use a social sign-in provider cannot use this reset process.

How to Access: On the sign-in page, click Forgot your password?

Captured 25 October 2026.

docs.title: How to Reset Your Password
docs.text: The password recovery process has three steps:

docs.title: Step 1: Enter Your Email Address
docs.text:
1. On the sign-in page, click Forgot your password?
  2. Enter the email address registered to your account
  3. Click Next

Field:

  • Email address (required): Enter the address registered to your account. A username alone is not accepted.

Validation:

  • Must match the primary email address on an active account

Errors:

  • "No account found for that email address": Check the address and try again, or speak to your association administrator.
  • Social sign-in accounts cannot reset their password through this page. Sign in through the account's social provider instead.

docs.title: Step 2: Answer Your Secret Question
docs.text:
1. Your saved secret question appears on the screen
  2. Enter the secret answer you provided during account setup
  3. Click Submit

Field:

  • Secret Answer (required): The answer to your security question

Validation:

  • Answers are case-sensitive; match your original capitalisation
  • Remove extra spaces and leading/trailing whitespace
  • Must match exactly what you entered when you created your account

Tips:

  • ✅ Think carefully about how you originally answered
  • ✅ If you have alternate spellings in mind, try each one
  • ✅ Note: "Fluffy" ≠ "fluffy" - case matters!

Common Issues:

  • The secret answer is not correct: Check its spelling and capitalisation. If you're unsure, contact your association administrator.
  • No secret question and answer are saved: MOS asks you to contact your association administrator.
  • Social sign-in account: Sign in through Microsoft or Google instead of using this recovery process.
  • Account not linked to Microsoft sign-in: Contact your association administrator for a reset.

docs.title: Step 3: Receive Your New Temporary Password
docs.text:
1. A new temporary password is generated
  2. The password is sent to your registered email address
  3. Check your email for a message from Match Official System
  4. Your email will contain your new temporary password
  5. Copy the temporary password from the email
  6. Return to the sign in page
  7. Sign in with your email and the temporary password
  8. Result: You'll be prompted to change your password on first sign-in

Password Requirements:

When you sign in and change from your temporary password, your new password must meet these criteria:

  • Minimum 8 characters
  • At least one uppercase letter (A-Z)
  • At least one lowercase letter (a-z)
  • At least one number (0-9)
  • Symbols recommended (!@#$%)

Creating a Strong Password:

  • ✅ Use a unique password for this system
  • ✅ Mix uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols
  • ✅ Avoid personal information (name, birthday, etc.)
  • ✅ Don't reuse passwords from other sites
  • ✅ Use a password manager to generate and store passwords

Avoid:

  • ❌ Common words or phrases ("password", "welcome")
  • ❌ Sequential numbers (123456)
  • ❌ Keyboard patterns (qwerty)
  • ❌ Your name or personal information
  • ❌ Words found in a dictionary

docs.title: If You Don't Receive the Reset Email
docs.text:
Check Spam/Junk Folder:

  • MOS emails may be filtered as spam
  • Search for sender: Match Official System
  • Check all tabs (Primary, Promotions, Social, etc.)
  • Move email to inbox and mark as "Not Spam"

Email Hasn't Arrived:

  1. Wait 5-10 minutes for delivery
  2. Ask your IT to allowlist the domain
  3. Check that you entered your correct email address
  4. Try the password recovery process again

Contact Your Administrator:

If emails still don't arrive, contact your association administrator:

  1. Explain that password reset emails aren't reaching you
  2. Ask them to manually reset your password
  3. They may:
    • Reset your password to a temporary one
    • Send you a temporary password via another method
    • Help you update your email address if it's incorrect

docs.title: When Password Recovery is Disabled
docs.text:
In some situations, self-service password recovery is not available.

Why Password Recovery Gets Disabled:

Password recovery cannot continue if your account has no saved secret question and answer, uses social sign-in, or is not linked to Microsoft sign-in.

docs.title: If Password Recovery is Disabled
docs.text:
You'll See: A message explaining why the reset cannot continue. For example, MOS asks you to contact your association administrator if no secret question and answer are saved.

Captured 25 October 2026.

How to Reset Your Password:

  1. Contact your association administrator and explain the message.
  2. Follow their instructions to regain access to your account.

After a name change, MOS may also tell you to contact your administrator if password recovery is unavailable.

docs.title: Account Not Found
docs.text:
Problem: MOS says no account was found for the email address.

What this means:

  • No active account matches the email address you entered.
  • You may have entered a typo or used a different email address.

Solutions:

  1. Double-Check Entry:

    • Check for typos and use the email address registered to your account.

  2. Try Email Recovery:

    • Go to your email provider
    • Search for emails from "Match Official System"
    • Check any password reset or confirmation emails
    • The email in those messages is your registered email

  3. Contact Administrator:

    • Tell them you can't find your account
    • Ask them to search for you in their user list
    • They can verify if an account exists
    • They can manually reset your password

docs.title: Wrong Secret Answer
docs.text:
Problem: "Incorrect answer" - you know your answer but it doesn't work

Common Causes:

  • Capitalisation: Answers are case-sensitive. "Red" ≠ "red"
  • Extra spaces: Even one extra space means it won't match
  • Different spelling: You may have typed it differently originally
  • Memory: You may have misremembered how you answered

What to Try:

  1. Try Different Capitalisation:

    • Original: "Boston" → Try: "boston" or "BOSTON"
    • Original: "French Bulldog" → Try: "french bulldog"

  2. Try Without Spaces:

    • Original: "New York" → Try: "newyork"

  3. Try Alternate Spellings:

    • Original: "Fluffy" → Try: "Fluffy" (if you type with extra letters)

  4. Contact Administrator:

    • If multiple attempts fail
    • They can reset your password without needing the secret answer
    • They may help you update your secret question

docs.title: Email Address No Longer Valid
docs.text:
Problem: Password reset emails aren't reaching you; your email changed

Solutions:

  1. Update Your Email:

    • If you can still sign in, go to My Account → Update Email
    • Change to a current email address
    • Then password recovery will work

  2. Contact Administrator:

    • Tell them your email is outdated
    • Ask them to:
      • Update your email address in the system
      • Manually reset your password
    • Once updated, password recovery will work normally

docs.title: Tips for Password Recovery Success
docs.text:
• ✅ Use a unique, strong password
  • ✅ Write your secret question and answer in a secure password manager
  • ✅ Keep your registered email address active and monitored
  • ✅ Update your email if it changes
  • ✅ Change your password every 90 days
  • ✅ Never share your password with anyone

docs.title: Related Pages
docs.text:
• Sign In - Sign in to your account
  • Register - Create a new account
  • Change Password - Change your password while signed in
  • Admin User Management - Administrators resetting passwords

docs.title: Sign In: Access Your Account
docs.text:
Access Level

Public (before authentication)

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Sign in to access your Match Official System account. The sign-in page is hosted by Microsoft and includes email and password sign-in, plus the Microsoft and Google options enabled for MOS.

Captured 25 October 2026.

How to Access: Go to matchofficialsystem.com and you are redirected to Azure AD B2C to sign in.

Note

If you do not have an account, contact your association administrator for an invitation

docs.title: How to Sign In
docs.text:
1. Go to matchofficialsystem.com
  2. On the sign-in page, enter your registered email address and password. Both fields appear on the same page.
  3. Optional: Select Keep me signed in on a device you trust.
  4. Click Sign in.
  5. Result: You are authenticated and returned to Match Official System.

After Sign In:

  • You are taken to the Home page

Fields (in Azure AD B2C):

  • Email Address (required): The email address registered to your account
  • Password (required): Your account password
  • Forgot your password?: Opens MOS password recovery (see Forgot Password)
  • Keep me signed in (optional): Keeps you signed in for longer on a trusted device

Errors:

  • "Account not found": Check for typos in the registered email address
  • "Incorrect password": Verify Caps Lock is off; try password recovery
  • Account temporarily locked: You may have entered incorrect password multiple times — wait a few minutes and try again

docs.title: Keep Me Signed In
docs.text:
When you check Keep me signed in in Azure AD B2C, your session is extended.

How it works:

  • Selecting this option requests a longer sign-in session on the current device. The sign-in policy determines how long it lasts.

When to use it:

  • On your personal computer
  • On your personal phone
  • When you use the system frequently
  • On devices you trust

When NOT to use it:

  • On shared computers
  • On public computers (libraries, airports, schools)
  • When using someone else's device
  • On computers at work shared with others

Security: Your authentication is protected by Microsoft Azure AD B2C enterprise security.

docs.title: Session Timeout
docs.text:
Your session ends automatically after a period of inactivity to protect your account.

What happens:

  • Your sign-in may expire after a period of inactivity
  • You are automatically signed out
  • Unsaved changes can be lost if your session expires

How to stay signed in:

  • Select Keep me signed in when using a device you trust
  • Actively use the system (refresh activity timer)
  • Save your work regularly

If you're signed out:

  1. Go to matchofficialsystem.com
  2. Sign in with your email and password
  3. You'll be returned to the system

Tip: Save your work regularly to avoid losing changes when your session ends.

docs.title: Forgot Your Password
docs.text: If you forget your password, you can reset it.

docs.title: How to Reset Your Password
docs.text:
1. On the sign-in page, click Forgot your password?
  2. Enter the email address registered to your account on the MOS password recovery page.
  3. Click Next and follow the recovery steps.

See Forgot Password for detailed instructions.

docs.title: Account Lockout
docs.text: If you enter the wrong password several times, your account may be temporarily locked for security.

docs.title: If Your Account Is Locked
docs.text:
1. Wait a few minutes before trying again
  2. Your account will automatically unlock
  3. Try signing in again with the correct password
  4. If locked again, use Forgot your password? to reset
  5. Contact your administrator if you need immediate help

Why this happens: Multiple failed password attempts trigger a temporary security lockout to protect against brute force attacks. This is normal and your account automatically recovers.

docs.title: Maintenance Mode
docs.text:
During scheduled maintenance, you may not be able to sign in.

What you see:

  • A maintenance notice on the sign in page
  • A message preventing you from signing in

What to do:

  • Wait and try again later
  • Check association communications for updates

docs.title: Signing Out
docs.text:
When you're finished using the system, sign out to protect your account.

How to Sign Out:

  1. Click your profile name or avatar in the top-right corner
  2. Click Sign Out
  3. Result: You are signed out and return to the sign-in page

docs.title: Can't sign in
docs.text:
1. Use Forgot your password? to reset your password
  2. Check your Caps Lock is off
  3. Check the email address for typing errors or extra spaces
  4. Clear your browser cookies and try again

docs.title: Don't know which email address you registered
docs.text:
1. Contact your association administrator to confirm the email address on your account.
  2. Use Forgot your password? if you need to reset your password.

docs.title: New device not recognised
docs.text:
1. Complete sign-in normally
  2. If prompted, verify your email address
  3. You may need additional verification on first login from a new device

docs.title: Page loops after sign-in
docs.text:
Symptoms: You sign in but return to the login page

How to Fix:

  1. Clear your browser cookies and cache
  2. Try a different browser
  3. Try disabling browser extensions
  4. Contact your administrator if the problem continues

docs.title: Still can't sign in
docs.text:
1. Verify you have an active account with your association
  2. Check your internet connection is stable
  3. Try the system on a different network
  4. Contact your administrator for help

docs.title: Tips
docs.text:
• ✅ Use a password manager for strong, unique passwords
  • ✅ Enable email notifications and keep your email updated
  • ✅ Log out from shared devices after each session
  • ❌ Don't use "Keep me signed in" on shared devices
  • ❌ Don't share your password with anyone

docs.title: Related Pages
docs.text:
• Register: Create a new account with an invitation
  • Forgot Password: Reset your password
  • Update Email: Change your email address
  • Linked Accounts: Link Microsoft or Google accounts for easier sign-in

docs.title: Register: Create Your Account
docs.text:
Access Level

Public (with invitation link required)

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Registration uses Microsoft Azure AD B2C to create your account securely. You'll receive an invitation link from your association, then set up your account through a simple process.

How to Access: Click the registration link in your invitation email

Warning

You cannot self-register without an invitation link. Contact your association administrator if you need access

docs.title: Before You Start
docs.text:
Requirements:

  • Valid email address (personal or work)
  • Registration link from your association administrator
  • Access to your email for account creation

How you'll receive your link:

Your administrator will share the link via:

  • Email
  • Chat or messaging app
  • Document or shared workspace
  • Phone or in-person meeting
  • Any method your administrator chooses

docs.title: Invitation Links
docs.text:
Your association administrator generates registration links when they want to allow people to sign up. Each link is unique to your group and doesn't expire.

Important: If your administrator disables and then re-enables registrations, the link changes. Ask your administrator for the current link.

docs.title: Group Association
docs.text:
When you click the registration link, you'll see your association's:

  • Group logo
  • Association name
  • Group information

This confirms you're registering for the correct organisation.

docs.title: Step 1: Get Your Registration Link
docs.text:
Your association administrator will provide you with a registration link. They may share it by:

  • Email
  • Team messaging platform (Slack, Microsoft Teams, etc.)
  • Document or shared drive
  • SMS or phone call
  • In person

The registration link is unique to your group and typically looks like this: https://matchofficialsystem.com/register?ID=YourUniqueGroupCode

For example: https://matchofficialsystem.com/register?ID=951a632a-1e4d-4368-89e7-776c08b10acd

docs.title: Step 2: Click Your Registration Link
docs.text:
1. When you're ready to register, click the registration link your administrator shared
  2. Your browser opens the MOS registration page
  3. You'll see your association's logo and name, confirming you have the correct link
  4. Click Next to begin registration
  5. You'll be redirected to Microsoft Azure AD B2C to create your account

If Your Link Doesn't Work:

  • Your administrator may have disabled registrations and then re-enabled them (this changes the link)
  • Contact your association administrator for the current link
  • They can provide you with the updated registration link

docs.title: Step 3: Create Your Account in Azure AD B2C
docs.text:
You're now in Microsoft Azure AD B2C, which handles account creation securely.

Enter Your Email:

  1. Enter your email address

    • Use an email you have permanent access to
    • Can be personal (gmail.com, outlook.com) or work email
    • Example: firstname.lastname@company.com

  2. Create a password

    • Minimum 8 characters
    • Include uppercase letters (A-Z)
    • Include lowercase letters (a-z)
    • Include numbers (0-9)
    • Symbols recommended (!@#$%)
    • Example: MySecure123!Pass

Important: Your email and password are used to sign in every time. Remember them.

  1. Provide your name

    • Given Name: Your first/given name
    • Surname: Your family/last name

  2. Click Create to complete account creation

What happens next:

  • Your account is created in Azure AD B2C
  • You're automatically signed in
  • You're returned to Match Official System
  • You're taken to the Home page

docs.title: Step 4: Welcome to Match Official System
docs.text:
You're now signed in and can:

  • View the Home dashboard
  • Access news and announcements
  • Start assigned work
  • Explore the system

Next Steps:

  1. Update Your Profile: Click My Account → Update Profile to add details like address and phone number
  2. Change Your Password: Click My Account → Change Password if you want a different password
  3. Contact Your Administrator: If you need help or have questions about your access level

docs.title: Registration Link Issues
docs.text:
Problem: Registration link doesn't work

What to try:

  1. Check the URL:

    • Ensure you copied the entire link correctly
    • Check for spaces or line breaks if pasted from email or another source
    • Try clicking the link directly instead of copying and pasting

  2. Link Changed:

    • If your administrator disabled and then re-enabled registrations, the link changes
    • Ask your administrator for the current registration link
    • They can provide you with the updated link immediately

  3. Group No Longer Exists:

    • The association may have been deactivated or removed
    • Contact the administrator who sent you the link for clarification

docs.title: Registrations Closed
docs.text:
Problem: "Registrations are currently closed for this group" or "License limit reached"

What this means:

  • Your association stopped allowing new registrations
  • Your association reached its user limit
  • Contact your administrator to:
    • Reopen registrations
    • Increase the user limit
    • Add you manually

docs.title: Email Already Registered
docs.text:
Problem: During Azure AD B2C registration, you get "This email is already in use"

What this means:

  • An account with this email already exists in the system
  • You may have registered previously
  • Someone else may be using this email

Solutions:

  1. Try Signing In:

    • Go to matchofficialsystem.com
    • Click Sign In (not Register)
    • Use your email and password

  2. Forgot Password:

    • Click "Forgot my password"
    • Reset your password
    • Sign in with your new password

  3. Use Different Email:

    • If you must use a different email, start the registration link again
    • Enter a different email address
    • After account creation, you can update your email in Profile settings

  4. Contact Administrator:

    • Tell them the email address that's registered
    • They can verify your account status
    • They can reset your password if needed

docs.title: Password Too Weak
docs.text:
Problem: "Password does not meet complexity requirements"

Azure AD B2C requires:

  • Minimum 8 characters (you entered too few)
  • At least one uppercase letter (A-Z)
  • At least one lowercase letter (a-z)
  • At least one number (0-9)
  • Symbols recommended: !@#$%^&*

Examples of strong passwords:

  • ✅ MySecure123!Pass
  • ✅ Summer2024@Beach
  • ✅ Hockey#Team99

Passwords to avoid:

  • ❌ password123 (too common)
  • ❌ 12345678 (all numbers)
  • ❌ ABCDEFGH (all letters, no numbers)
  • ❌ abc123 (too short)
  • ❌ Your name or birthday

docs.title: Account Creation Fails
docs.text:
Problem: You get an error during account creation

What to try:

  1. Clear Browser Cache:

    • Close your browser completely
    • Clear cache and cookies
    • Restart your browser
    • Click the registration link again

  2. Try Different Browser:

    • Try Chrome, Firefox, or Edge
    • Browser extensions may interfere
    • Try disabling extensions

  3. Check Email Format:

    • Must be valid format: name@domain.com
    • No spaces or special characters except @
    • Example: john.smith@company.com

  4. Wait and Retry:

    • If there's a system issue, wait 5-10 minutes
    • Try the registration link again
    • Contact your administrator if it keeps failing

docs.title: After Registration
docs.text: Once your account is created, you're signed in and ready to use the system.

docs.title: First Things to Do
docs.text:
1. Explore the Home Page:

    • View the dashboard
    • See any announcements or news
    • Check assigned work or assessments

  2. Update Your Profile (Optional):

    • Click My Account → Update Profile
    • Add your address, phone number, and other details
    • Upload a profile picture
    • Choose your preferred theme

  3. Change Your Password (Optional):

    • You can change your password anytime
    • Click My Account → Change Password
    • Your password is shared across the system

  4. Contact Your Administrator:

    • If you have questions about your access
    • If you need a different role or permissions
    • For onboarding or setup instructions

docs.title: Your Account
docs.text:
Remember:

  • ✅ Your email is your username for signing in
  • ✅ Keep your password secure and don't share it
  • ✅ Your name appears on official assessments
  • ✅ Administrators can see your activity and profile
  • ✅ You can update your profile information anytime

docs.title: Related Pages
docs.text:
• Sign In - How to sign in to your account
  • Forgot Password - Reset your password
  • Change Password - Update your password
  • Profile Management - Manage your account details

docs.title: If you are new to MOS
docs.text:
Request seven days of owner access to the demo organisation at matchofficialsystem.com/demo-register.

The registration form asks for your name and email, which MOS features you would like to explore (for example, referee assessments, appointments, or training), and optionally the association or group name. MOS emails a verification link that remains valid for two hours before creating an account. If eligible, you will receive a demo welcome email with a temporary password and the date your access ends. You can also open the form from the group sign-up page if you want to explore the demo before creating a group.

At your first sign-in, choose a new password and complete the current MOS policy onboarding. Your owner access lasts seven days. At the end of that period, MOS removes the demo access and account. You can request another demo account using the same email after a further seven days.

docs.title: If you already own an MOS association
docs.text:
Sign in to MOS with your existing owner account and open the organisation selector. Choose MOS Demo to switch to the shared demo organisation; no separate demo registration is needed. MOS adds temporary owner access to the demo for existing association owners. Your own organisation remains available in the selector, so you can switch back at any time.

The demo is shared, so other people may be exploring it at the same time. Demo records and files reset each day, so save anything you need to keep outside the demo.

Whether you registered for access or already own an MOS association, use View as demo official to explore the system with fictional demo profiles and their different roles. You can exit the preview to return to your owner account at any time.

docs.title: Preview a Demo Official
docs.text:
Select MOS Demo from the organisation selector, then choose View as demo official in the left navigation. Search for a seeded profile by name and check the listed role and subgroup before opening the preview. Most profiles are basic members; selected profiles demonstrate Viewer, Reviewer, Trainer, and Selector access.

The preview shows the selected official's name and role in the Official preview banner. Page access and available actions follow that profile's permissions. The preview uses fictional records in MOS Demo; it does not create a sign-in account for the selected official or switch to another organisation. Choose Exit preview to return to your normal demo owner access.

For Match Day examples, Jordan Lee and Avery Stone each have two reviewed entries. Other Match Day examples are assigned to additional fictional officials.

docs.title: Errors
docs.text:
• Overview
  • What You Might See
  • What To Do
  • When To Contact Support

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: The site shows friendly error pages when something goes wrong or a page cannot be found.

docs.title: What You Might See
docs.text:
• General error page when an unexpected problem occurs.
  • Not found page when a page cannot be found. It shows How did you get here? 404! and a link to Home.

Captured 25 October 2026.

docs.title: What To Do
docs.text:
• Refresh the page and try again.
  • If you were following a link, return to the previous page and retry the action.
  • If you are not signed in, sign in and repeat the action.
  • Check that any filters or search terms are valid and try again.

docs.title: When To Contact Support
docs.text:
Contact support when:

  • The same error repeats after retrying
  • You can't access a page you believe you should see

How to contact support:

  • Contact your association directly
  • Reach out to the MOS support team in the system

To help us diagnose the issue, provide:

  • Approximate time of the error
  • Page or feature you were accessing
  • Steps taken when the error occurred

docs.title: How do I reset my password?
docs.text:
1. Go to the sign-in page
  2. Click Forgot my password
  3. Enter your email address
  4. Answer your secret security question
  5. Check your email for a temporary password
  6. Sign in with the temporary password
  7. You'll be prompted to set a new permanent password

For detailed instructions, see Forgot Password.

docs.title: Can I sign in with my Microsoft or Google account?
docs.text:
Yes! You can link your Microsoft or Google account to your Match Official System account:

  1. Sign in with your regular password first
  2. Go to My Account → Profile Settings
  3. Find the Linked Accounts section
  4. Click Link Microsoft Account or Link Google Account
  5. After linking, you can sign in using the social login buttons on the login page

For more details, see Linked Accounts.

docs.title: How do I change my email address?
docs.text:
You can change your own email address:

  1. Sign in to your account
  2. Go to My Account → Update Email
  3. Enter your new email address
  4. Confirm with your current password
  5. Your email will be updated

See Update Email for step-by-step instructions.

docs.title: How do I change my password?
docs.text:
If you know your current password:

  1. Sign in to your account
  2. Go to My Account → Change Password
  3. Enter your current password
  4. Enter your new password twice
  5. Click Save

Note: If you signed in with Microsoft or Google (social account), you must change your password through that provider, not in Match Official System.

See Change Password for more information.

docs.title: Can I have different profile pictures for different groups?
docs.text: Yes. If you belong to multiple groups, you can set different pictures for each group through your profile settings.

docs.title: Unsubscribe from emails
docs.text:
My Account → Profile Details → set "Unsubscribe from MOS automated emails?" to Yes.

Owners of manually billed groups receive licence reminders 90, 60, and 30 days before expiry. If the licence expires, access ends; 7 days later, the owner receives the scheduled deletion date, which is 90 days after expiry. Owners can turn off these emails in My Account → Profile Details. Turning off all MOS automated emails also stops licence expiry emails.

docs.title: Upload media to reviews
docs.text: Use assessment upload areas or link to external sources (YouTube, Dropbox, OneDrive) with view-only share links.

docs.title: How do I register for an account?
docs.text:
You need an invitation link from your association administrator:

  1. Your administrator will share a registration link with you (via email, chat, document, etc.)
  2. Click the link
  3. You'll be taken to Azure AD B2C to create your account
  4. Enter your email and create a password
  5. Your account is created and you can sign in

See Register: Create Your Account for detailed instructions.

docs.title: Why can't I self-register?
docs.text: Registration requires an invitation from your association administrator. This ensures only authorized members can create accounts and helps maintain licensing compliance.

docs.title: The registration link isn't working
docs.text:
If your registration link doesn't work:

  • Check if signup is enabled: The link changes when your administrator disables and re-enables signup. Ask for the current link.
  • Try a different browser: Clear your cache or use incognito/private mode
  • Contact your administrator: They can provide a fresh link or check if signup is currently enabled

docs.title: Email validation errors
docs.text: Error Solution "Email addresses do not match" Carefully re-enter both fields; check for extra spaces "Not a valid email address" Ensure email is in valid format (name@domain.com) "Email already exists" This email is registered; use sign in or password recovery "Password does not meet requirements" Must be 8+ characters with uppercase, lowercase, and number

docs.title: What are the password requirements?
docs.text:
Your password must meet these Azure AD B2C requirements:

  • Minimum 8 characters
  • At least one uppercase letter (A-Z)
  • At least one lowercase letter (a-z)
  • At least one number (0-9)
  • Symbols are recommended (!@#$%) but not required

docs.title: I forgot to set up my security question
docs.text:
Your security question is required for password recovery. If you didn't set it up during registration:

  1. Sign in to your account
  2. Go to My Account → Change Password
  3. Set up your security question and answer
  4. This will enable self-service password recovery

See Change Password for instructions.

For detailed registration help, see Register: Create Your Account.

docs.title: Can we start with fewer users and add later?
docs.text:
Yes. You can start with one 50‑user block and purchase additional blocks as you grow. Costs are typically pro rata if you add users mid‑year.

Captured 25 October 2026.

docs.title: What happens if we exceed our user limit?
docs.text: Contact your administrator or Cortana Design immediately. You'll need to purchase additional user blocks to continue adding members.

docs.title: Are subgroups required?
docs.text: No. You can operate with no subgroups (everyone in one group). Subgroups are optional and help organise larger associations.

docs.title: Can we customise the number of users per block?
docs.text: Standard pricing uses 50‑user blocks. Contact Cortana Design to discuss custom licensing arrangements.

docs.title: What support is included?
docs.text: Support includes access to this documentation, email support and assistance with technical issues. Premium support may be available for an additional cost.

docs.title: Is there a trial period?
docs.text: Contact Cortana Design to enquire about trial licences or pilot programmes.

docs.title: Can we change our subscription mid‑year?
docs.text:
Yes. You can add users, subgroups or features mid‑year with pro rata costs. Reductions may be refunded or credited towards the next period.

For detailed subscription information, see Licensing and Subscription.

docs.title: AI Features
docs.text:
AI-assisted tools to help members, reviewers, and administrators work more efficiently. AI features are an optional add-on available on any MOS subscription.

Access Level

AI features require the AI add-on to be enabled on your subscription. Individual features are configured per group in Group Settings, with access levels set per role.

Includes:

  • AI Text Rewriting - Rewrite selected text or a complete rich-text field in assessments, plans, reviews, templates, exams, news, and profiles
  • Official Summary - Generate a short narrative summary of an official's recent activity and performance from their diary entries, assessments, and plans
  • Review Context - Automatic AI briefing shown when writing a review, drawing on the official's recent history to give you context before you begin
  • Season Review Generator - Generate a comprehensive multi-paragraph season narrative covering performance, strengths, development areas, and forward-looking priorities
  • Trainer - Complete approved scenario packs or, for authorised trainers, create AI-assisted draft packs and scenarios from selected development evidence
  • Exam Question Drafting - Generate private, source-grounded question drafts that require human verification before they are added to an exam

Access Level

Includes:

  • Create, edit, and cancel events
  • Assign officials to events with role and notes
  • Track appointment responses (Accepted, Declined, Pending)
  • View staffing status with colour-coded badges
  • Notify officials by push notification
  • Auto-Appoint using depth chart rankings
  • Round Templates to define required officials per grade
  • Import events and appointments from OfficialsHQ or CSV
  • Name and competition mappings for reliable imports
  • View group-wide availability matrix by month
  • Export availability to CSV
  • Export personal appointment schedule as a calendar file (.ics)

Learn more: My Appointments Managing Appointments Import Auto-Appoint Availability Roles and Venues

docs.title: Depth Charting
docs.text:
View and manage official ranking depth across grades and seasons.

Access Level

Viewing, manual ordering, and subjective score entry require Selector access. Scoring configuration, recalculation, and historical season management require Owner access.

Includes:

  • Cross grade overall ranking by season
  • Career progression charts and sortable season-by-season results
  • Historical season recalculation with progress and retry for failed calculations
  • Grade by grade tier charting
  • Official score breakdown by scoring factor
  • Manual ranking overrides
  • Subjective scoring tools
  • Tier and scoring configuration
  • CSV exports for overview and grade charts

Learn more: Depth Charting Overview Grade Depth Chart Score Breakdown Depth Scoring Config

Historical recalculation uses current scoring rules and diary, assessment, and plan activity settings. It preserves selector ordering and availability settings; it does not recreate past scoring settings. See Depth Charting Overview for the Career Progression and backfill steps.

docs.text:
Access Level

Access depends on where the link appears

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Download files and media provided throughout the site. Files are stored in the library or attached to items such as news posts, assessments, and reports.

How to Access: Click a download link or media thumbnail wherever it appears throughout the system

docs.title: Understanding File Links
docs.text:
Files can appear in many places:

  • News articles (news-attached documents)
  • Assessment feedback (evidence and media)
  • Library folders (managed files and folders)
  • Reports (export files)
  • Email notifications (linked resources)

docs.title: How to Download a File
docs.text: Captured 25 October 2026.

docs.title: Single Click Download
docs.text:
1. Locate the file you want to download
  2. Click the file name
  3. Your browser's download dialog appears
  4. Choose a save location or accept the default (usually Downloads folder)
  5. Click Save or Download
  6. Result: The file downloads to your computer

docs.title: Browser Behaviour
docs.text:
Different browsers handle downloads differently:

  • Chrome: Auto-downloads to Downloads folder by default
  • Firefox: Asks where to save or uses Downloads folder
  • Edge: Auto-downloads or asks, depending on settings
  • Safari: Opens download dialog or saves automatically

Tip: Check your browser's download settings to customise where files are saved.

docs.title: Large File Downloads
docs.text:
For files over 10 MB:

  1. Ensure you have a stable internet connection
  2. Use Wi-Fi rather than mobile data if possible
  3. Allow extra time for the download to complete
  4. Do not close your browser until the download is finished

Common Download Sizes:

  • Documents (PDF, Word): 1-5 MB
  • Spreadsheets: 2-10 MB
  • Images and photos: 2-8 MB
  • Video files: 50 MB to 2+ GB
  • Compressed archives (ZIP): Variable

docs.title: Download from News Articles
docs.text:
1. Go to News
  2. Click Read more on an article
  3. Look for attachment links or a download section
  4. Click the file name or Download button
  5. Result: The file downloads

docs.title: Download Assessment Evidence
docs.text:
1. Go to Assessments
  2. Open an assessment or review
  3. Look for attached evidence or media files
  4. Click Download next to the file
  5. Result: The file downloads

docs.title: Download from Library (Media or Folders)
docs.text:
1. Go to Library → Folders or Media
  2. Navigate to the file you want
  3. Click the file name or Download button
  4. Result: The file downloads

For multiple files: Select files and click Download Selected to download as a ZIP archive (if enabled).

docs.title: Download Reports or Exports
docs.text:
1. Go to Reporting or an admin report page
  2. Click Export this data to CSV or similar button
  3. A CSV file downloads
  4. Open in Excel, Sheets, or a text editor
  5. Result: You can view, edit, and analyse the data

docs.title: Open Downloaded Files
docs.text:
After downloading, find your file:

  1. Click the browser's Downloads button (⬇️)
  2. Or check your Downloads folder:
    • Windows: C:\Users\YourName\Downloads
    • Mac: ~/Downloads
    • Chromebook: Files app
  3. Double-click the file to open it
  4. The file opens with your default application

docs.title: File Types and Default Applications
docs.text:
• PDF: PDF reader (Adobe, browser, or other)
  • Word (.docx): Microsoft Word or Google Docs
  • Excel (.xlsx): Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets
  • Images (.jpg, .png): Image viewer or browser
  • Video: Media player (VLC, Windows Media Player, etc.)
  • ZIP: Archive tool (Windows, Mac, or extraction software)

docs.title: Verify Downloaded Files
docs.text:
Check that your file downloaded completely:

  1. In your Downloads folder, check the file size
  2. Compare to the size shown in MOS (if displayed)
  3. If sizes don't match, re-download the file
  4. Scan downloaded files with antivirus software if from untrusted sources

docs.title: Download button doesn't work
docs.text:
Symptoms: Clicking download does nothing

How to Fix:

  1. Refresh the page and try again
  2. Try a different browser
  3. Check your browser's pop-up blocker (some block downloads)
  4. Disable browser extensions temporarily and try again
  5. Check your internet connection

Common Causes:

  • Browser compatibility issue
  • Browser security settings
  • Network interruption
  • File temporarily unavailable

docs.title: Permission denied or file not accessible
docs.text:
Symptoms: Error message says you don't have permission or the file doesn't exist

How to Fix:

  1. Verify you have access to the item (news, assessment, folder, etc.)
  2. Check your group membership and permissions
  3. Contact your administrator if you believe you should have access
  4. Try logging out and back in

Common Causes:

  • You don't have access to the group or subgroup
  • Your role doesn't include access to this item
  • File was removed or deleted
  • Sharing link expired

docs.title: File missing or deleted
docs.text:
Symptoms: The download link appears but the file is gone

How to Fix:

  1. Contact your administrator to confirm file location
  2. Ask if the file was archived or moved
  3. Request a new copy if it was recent
  4. Check if there's a backup version available

Common Causes:

  • File was deleted from library
  • File was moved to a different folder
  • Sharing link expired
  • File storage limit exceeded

docs.title: Slow or incomplete download
docs.text:
Symptoms: Download takes very long or stops before completing

How to Fix:

  1. Check your internet connection speed
  2. Try downloading again
  3. Switch from mobile data to Wi-Fi
  4. Use a wired connection instead of wireless
  5. Close other applications using bandwidth
  6. Try downloading at a different time

Common Causes:

  • Slow internet connection
  • Network congestion
  • Large file size
  • Browser timeout

docs.title: Browser warns about unsafe file
docs.text:
Symptoms: Browser shows "This file is unsafe" or similar warning

How to Fix:

  1. This is usually a false positive if the file came from MOS
  2. Click Keep or Download anyway to proceed
  3. Scan the file with antivirus software
  4. If you're concerned, ask your administrator about the file
  5. Never open unknown files from untrusted sources

Common Causes:

  • Executable files (.exe, .zip) may trigger warnings
  • Browser being overly cautious
  • File actually contains malware (rare from MOS)

docs.title: Tips and Best Practices
docs.text:
• ✅ Check file size before downloading on limited connections
  • ✅ Verify downloaded files are what you expected
  • ✅ Scan downloaded files with antivirus if concerned
  • ✅ Organise downloads into folders (Documents, Projects, etc.)
  • ✅ Keep important downloads backed up in another location
  • ❌ Don't open unexpected files from unknown sources
  • ❌ Don't ignore antivirus warnings
  • ❌ Don't download files if you don't recognise their source

docs.title: Groups and Associations
docs.text:
Reference

Understanding organisational structure in Match Official System

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: In Match Official System, a group (or association) is the logical boundary that defines a community of users who officiate a specific sporting code or organisation.

docs.title: What Is a Group/Association?
docs.text:
A group is:

  • A sporting organisation - Represents a league, federation, association, or governing body for a particular sport
  • A logical boundary for users - Contains all officials, administrators, reviewers, and other members who work for that organisation
  • A container for resources - Holds news, assessments, training materials, library files, and reports specific to that organisation
  • A permission scope - Controls who can see what data and features based on their role and group membership

docs.title: Examples
docs.text:
Common examples of groups/associations:

  • Football/Soccer league
  • Rugby union or rugby league organisation
  • Cricket association
  • Tennis federation
  • Basketball league
  • Netball association
  • Water polo federation

docs.title: Organisational Structure
docs.text:
Groups can have a hierarchical structure with subgroups:

  • Parent group - The main organisation (e.g., a national football league)
  • Subgroups - Divisions, regions, or sections within the parent (e.g., Northern Division, Southern Division)

Members can belong to the parent group and/or specific subgroups. Administrators can organise users into subgroups based on geography, competition level, or other criteria.

Captured 25 October 2026.

docs.title: Data Visibility
docs.text:
• You only see news, announcements, and reports from your group and subgroups
  • You can only interact with users who are members of your group or shared subgroups
  • Your assessments and diaries are scoped to your group

docs.title: Features and Settings
docs.text:
• Group administrators control which features are enabled (e.g., whether News notifications are available)
  • Settings such as the calendar start date, time zone, and quick links are configured per group
  • Theme and branding can be customised per group

docs.title: Access Levels and Roles
docs.text:
• Your access level (User or Owner) and roles (Viewer, Reviewer, Trainer, Communications, Files Manager) are specific to each group
  • You might have different roles in different groups
  • For example, you could be an Owner in one group but have only the Reviewer role in another

  • Membership and Roles - Manage group members and permissions (Owner access required)

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
The Home page provides a dashboard with your welcome message, recent news, shortcuts, upcoming appointments, summary charts, and recent activity. The content and available shortcuts depend on your role and selected organisation.

How to Access: Click Home

docs.title: Welcome Message
docs.text:
• Greets you by name
  • Shows important system notices or license information
  • Displays current system version number

docs.title: News Section
docs.text:
• Shows the most recent news articles from your association
  • Displays up to 3 recent items
  • Click any item to read the full article

docs.title: Quick Actions
docs.text:
Shortcuts to tasks available to you. Depending on your role and selected organisation, these can include starting a review or opening your assessments and plans. If a shortcut is not shown, open the relevant page from the main menu.

Captured 25 October 2026. Available shortcuts depend on your role and selected organisation.

docs.title: Upcoming Appointments
docs.text:
When you have upcoming appointments, this section summarises them on the Home page. Open Appointments then My Appointments to see appointment details, respond to a request, link an appointment to a diary entry, or create a diary entry with the fixture details filled in.

Captured 25 October 2026. The names and fixture details shown are fictional.

docs.title: Summary Charts
docs.text:
Visual summaries of your diary and assessment activity and plan entries. Where available, use the season or year filter to change the period shown.

Note

Charts update based on the time period you select

docs.title: Depth Coverage (administrative access)
docs.text:
This card appears on the Home page for users with administrative access. It summarises grade coverage for the current season to date, or the last completed season when current-season results are unavailable. For the current season, scores are prorated.

The card shows the number of grades with results, whether coverage is healthy or needs attention, and tier counts for up to six grades. Each grade shows its coverage status and effective Match Ready count. Click a grade to open its Grade Chart. If a grade needs attention, open Depth Charting to review the full coverage summary and rankings.

Captured 25 October 2026. Names and sample records shown are fictional.

docs.title: Recent Activity
docs.text:
• Timeline of your recent actions
  • Shows diary entries, plans, exams, and reviews
  • Click any item to view details

docs.title: How to Open a Diary or Review Task
docs.text:
1. On the Home page, find Quick Actions
  2. Choose an available shortcut for the task you want to do
  3. Result: The selected form or list opens. Available shortcuts vary by role and organisation.

docs.title: How to Open Your Plans
docs.text:
1. On the Home page, find Quick Actions
  2. Choose View Plans if it is available
  3. Result: Your plans open. Available shortcuts vary by role and organisation.

docs.title: How to Read a News Article
docs.text:
1. On the Home page, find the News section
  2. Click any article title
  3. Result: The full article opens with any attachments

docs.title: How to Filter Charts by Season
docs.text:
1. Find the Summary charts section
  2. Look for the season or year filter option
  3. Select your preferred time period
  4. Result: Charts update to show data for the selected period

Note: This option appears when available for your association

docs.title: Review Depth Coverage (administrative access)
docs.text:
1. On the Home page, find Depth Coverage.
  2. Review the season label and the coverage status for each listed grade.
  3. Click a grade to open its Grade Chart.
  4. To review all grades and season rankings, click Depth Charting.
  5. Result: The grade chart opens for the selected grade and season.

docs.title: How to View Activity Details
docs.text:
1. Find the Recent activity section
  2. Click any activity item
  3. Result: The full details open

docs.title: Administrator shortcuts do not appear
docs.text:
Symptoms: You do not see admin links in Quick Actions

How to Fix:

  1. Check which group you have selected
  2. Verify your role includes administrator access
  3. Contact your association administrator to confirm your permissions

Common Causes:

  • You do not have administrator access for the selected group
  • Your role does not include admin features

docs.title: Charts are empty
docs.text:
Symptoms: Summary charts show no data

How to Fix:

  1. Try selecting a different time period in the filter
  2. Check back later after completing some activities
  3. Verify you have diary entries or plans recorded

Common Causes:

  • No activity recorded for the selected time period
  • Filters are too narrow
  • You have just joined and have no history yet

docs.title: Depth Coverage is empty or unavailable
docs.text:
Symptoms The card says there are no depth results, or that coverage is temporarily unavailable.

How to Fix

  1. If the current season has just started, check again after depth results have been calculated.
  2. Open Depth Charting > Overview to review coverage and rankings.
  3. Contact your organisation owner if results remain unavailable.

Common Causes

  • No depth results have been calculated for the displayed season
  • Coverage could not be loaded; refresh the Home page and try again

docs.title: News section is empty
docs.text:
Symptoms: No news articles appear

How to Fix:

  1. Navigate to the full News page to see all articles
  2. Ask your administrator if news has been published
  3. Verify your membership status

Common Causes:

  • No recent news published
  • News was published to other subgroups

docs.title: Related Pages
docs.text:
• News: View all news articles
  • Assessments: Manage diary entries and plans
  • Profile Management: Update your profile
  • Admin: Depth Charting Overview: Review rankings, career progression, and full grade coverage

docs.title: Levels of Access
docs.text: Match Official System uses a flexible role-based permission system. Users are assigned an access level (User or Owner) plus any combination of specific roles. This allows fine-grained control over what each person can do.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Access is controlled through two components:

  1. Access Level: Either User (standard member) or Owner (full administrator)
  2. Roles: Specific permissions that can be combined as needed

A person can have multiple roles at once. For example, someone could be a Reviewer and a Trainer, giving them permissions from both roles.

Captured 25 October 2026. This example is from AI feature settings; available roles vary by feature.

docs.title: User
docs.text:
User

Description: Standard member access with personal workspace

Permissions:

  • Create diary and plan entries
  • Search users in their group(s)
  • Sit exams
  • Access personal user folder (if enabled)
  • Upload files to personal user folder

docs.title: Owner
docs.text:
Owner

Description: Full administrative control of the group

Permissions:

  • All User permissions
  • Create, edit, and delete user accounts
  • Modify group settings
  • Modify assessment templates
  • Manage exam questions and answers
  • Manage news and announcements
  • Full access to all folders and files
  • Assign roles to other members

docs.title: Roles
docs.text: Roles grant specific permissions and can be combined. A user can have multiple roles assigned.

docs.title: Viewer
docs.text:
Viewer

Permissions:

  • Create assessments (match day, media, season, general review) on other users
  • View assessment lists and history
  • View subgroup folders they are assigned to (read-only)

docs.title: Reviewer
docs.text:
Reviewer

Permissions:

  • Review diary and plan entries that are awaiting review
  • Provide feedback on shared assessments
  • Run reports on the group
  • View assessment lists (but cannot create assessments without Viewer role)
  • View subgroup folders they are assigned to (read-only)

docs.title: Trainer
docs.text:
Trainer

Permissions:

  • Access the Exam Management section
  • Create, edit, and manage exams
  • Export exam results
  • View exam completion activity

Note

The Trainer role is only available at the group level, not subgroup level.

docs.title: Communications
docs.text:
Communications

Permissions:

  • Access the News Management section
  • Create, edit, and publish news articles
  • Manage news distribution

Note

The Communications role is only available at the group level, not subgroup level.

docs.title: Files Manager
docs.text:
Files Manager

Permissions:

  • Create and delete folders
  • Upload and delete files in group and subgroup folders
  • Move and rename files and folders
  • Generate share links for files

docs.title: Appointer
docs.text:
Appointer

Permissions:

  • Create, edit, and cancel appointment events
  • Assign officials to events and manage appointments
  • View and export group-wide availability
  • Access the Auto-Appoint tool
  • Import events and appointments from external files
  • Manage import mappings (name and competition)
  • Send appointment notifications to officials

Note

Configuring appointment roles and venues requires Owner access. The Appointer role grants management of appointments only.

docs.title: Selector
docs.text:
Selector

Permissions:

  • View the depth chart across all grades
  • Manually reorder officials on the depth chart
  • Enter subjective scores for officials
  • Export depth chart data to CSV

Note

Configuring depth chart scoring and triggering recalculations requires Owner access.

docs.title: Common Role Combinations
docs.text:
Here are some typical ways roles are combined:

Person Type Access Level Roles Regular member User None Coach who reviews diaries User Reviewer Coach who creates assessments and reviews User Viewer + Reviewer Exam coordinator User Trainer News publisher User Communications File administrator User Files Manager Appointments coordinator User Appointer Appointments coordinator with depth chart access User Appointer + Selector Group administrator Owner (has all permissions)

docs.title: Understanding Folder Access
docs.text: Folder permissions depend on your access level and roles.

docs.title: Folder access for Users
docs.text:
• Access only to personal folder: User/{username} (if enabled)
  • Upload and delete files only inside personal folder
  • Cannot access group or subgroup folders

docs.title: Folder access for Viewers
docs.text:
• Can view subgroup folders they are assigned to (read-only)
  • Cannot upload, create, or delete files outside personal folder

docs.title: Folder access for Reviewers
docs.text:
• Same as Viewer - can view subgroup folders they are assigned to (read-only)
  • Reviewer role is for reviewing diary and plan entries, not file management

docs.title: Folder access for Files Managers
docs.text:
• Can create, rename, move, and delete folders and files
  • Can generate share links
  • Full file management within their assigned areas

docs.title: Folder access for Owners
docs.text:
• Full folder control across the group and all subgroups
  • Can manage all files and folders
  • Can generate share links for any file

docs.title: Typical folder layout
docs.text:
Home/
├── user/                   (personal user folders, if enabled)
│   ├── john.smith/
│   ├── jane.doe/
│   └── ...
├── subgroups/              (if enabled)
│   ├── Northern Division/
│   ├── Southern Division/
│   └── ...
├── Documents/
├── Photos/
└── Resources/

docs.title: Can I upload files?
docs.text:
• User (no roles): Only to your personal folder
  • Viewer: Only to your personal folder
  • Reviewer: Only to your personal folder (Reviewer is for assessments, not files)
  • Files Manager: To all assigned folders
  • Owner: To all group and subgroup folders

docs.title: Can I delete files?
docs.text:
• User (no roles): Only files you created in your personal folder
  • Viewer: No
  • Reviewer: No
  • Files Manager: Yes, in assigned areas
  • Owner: Yes, any file in any folder

docs.title: Can I review assessments?
docs.text:
• User (no roles): No
  • Viewer: No (can create assessments, not review them)
  • Reviewer: Yes, for assessments awaiting review
  • Owner: Yes, all assessments

docs.title: Can I create exams?
docs.text:
• User (no roles): No (can only sit exams)
  • Viewer: No
  • Reviewer: No
  • Trainer: Yes
  • Owner: Yes

docs.title: Can I publish news?
docs.text:
• User (no roles): No
  • Viewer: No
  • Reviewer: No
  • Communications: Yes
  • Owner: Yes

docs.title: Can I run reports?
docs.text:
• User (no roles): No
  • Viewer: No
  • Reviewer: Yes
  • Owner: Yes

docs.title: Can I manage appointments?
docs.text:
• User (no roles): Can view own appointments and respond only
  • Appointer: Yes — create events, assign officials, import, auto-appoint
  • Owner: Yes, full access including configuring roles and venues

docs.title: Can I view group-wide availability?
docs.text:
• User (no roles): No
  • Appointer: Yes
  • Owner: Yes

docs.title: Can I view the depth chart?
docs.text:
• User (no roles): No
  • Selector: Yes
  • Owner: Yes

docs.title: Can I manage users?
docs.text:
• User (any roles): No
  • Owner: Yes, full user management

docs.title: Requesting Additional Roles
docs.text:
If you need additional permissions:

  1. Contact your group administrator (Owner)
  2. Explain what tasks you need to perform
  3. They can assign the appropriate roles in Membership and Roles

docs.title: Related Pages
docs.text:
• Groups and Associations: Understanding organisational structure
  • Admin: User Management: How administrators manage user accounts
  • Admin: Membership and Roles: Managing group members and roles
  • Library Folders: File management and folder access
  • Appointments: Managing events and officials (requires Appointer role)
  • Depth Charting: Selectors can view career progression and manage rankings; users with administrative access can run recalculations and update historical seasons

docs.title: Folders
docs.text:
Access Level

All users. Note however some permissions are controlled by your group administrator(s).

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Captured 25 October 2026.

The Folders page is the full-featured file manager for your group's storage. Use it to upload, organise, rename, move, and delete files and folders. For read-only assessment, news and profile picture browsing, see Media.

Capabilities:

  • Create folders and subfolders
  • Upload single or multiple files
  • Rename files and folders
  • Move items between folders
  • Generate secure, time-limited share links
  • Download files (and folders if ZIP download is enabled)
  • Delete files and folders

Permissions:

  • Access varies by role and subgroup.
  • Owners can manage all content; Users typically manage their own uploads.

docs.title: Understanding Folder Access
docs.text: Access to folders is controlled by your user role and group membership. Different roles have different permissions.

docs.title: Access by Role
docs.text:
User

  • Can access and upload to their own personal user folder (User/{your username})
  • Cannot create or delete folders outside their personal folder
  • Cannot delete files outside their personal folder
  • Can only see files they created in their personal folder

Viewer

  • Can access personal user folder (if enabled)
  • Can view and download files from subgroup folders if assigned to those subgroups
  • Cannot upload to subgroup folders
  • Cannot create or delete folders

Reviewer

  • Can access personal user folder (if enabled)
  • Can view and download files from subgroup folders they are assigned to (read-only)
  • Cannot upload to group or subgroup folders
  • Cannot create or delete folders

Files Manager

  • Can access personal user folder (if enabled)
  • Can view, upload, and download files from all group and subgroup folders
  • Can create, rename, move, and delete folders
  • Can delete files
  • Can generate share links for any file

Owner

  • Full access to all folders in the group and subgroups
  • Can create folders at any level
  • Can delete folders and files at any level
  • Can move files between folders
  • Can generate share links for any file
  • Unrestricted file management

docs.title: Special Folders
docs.text:
Your group may have special folders depending on configuration:

User Folder:

  • Located at the root level: User/{username}
  • Your personal storage space (if enabled by the group)
  • Only you can upload and delete files here
  • Others cannot access your personal folder

Subgroups Folder:

  • Shows team, regional, or division subfolders (if enabled)
  • Access depends on your subgroup membership
  • Viewers and Reviewers can view these folders (read-only)
  • Files Managers and Owners can upload, delete, and manage files

docs.title: Permissions and Actions
docs.text: Action User Viewer Reviewer Files Manager Owner View files Own folder only Subgroups Subgroups All folders All folders Upload files Personal folder No No All folders All folders Create folders No No No Yes Yes Delete files Own folder No No Yes Yes Delete folders No No No Yes Yes Move files Within personal No No All folders All folders Share files No No No Yes Yes Rename files Own folder No No Yes Yes

docs.title: Breadcrumb
docs.text:
• Shows the current path, e.g., Home > Documents > 2024 > Reports.
  • Click any level to jump there.
  • Use Up to go one level up; Home to return to root.

docs.title: Toolbar
docs.text:
• New Folder: Create a folder in the current path.
  • Upload Files: Choose files or drag-and-drop into the grid.
  • Refresh: Reload the current folder view.
  • Download Selected: Download selected files; folders may download as ZIP (if enabled).
  • Share: Create a temporary share link for the selected file.
  • Rename: Rename the selected file or folder.
  • Move: Move selected items to a different folder.
  • Delete: Permanently delete selected items.

docs.title: File Grid
docs.text:
• Columns: Select, Type, Name, Size, Modified, Actions.
  • Sort by clicking column headers; folders typically list before files.
  • Right-click an item for a context menu (Open, Download, Rename, Move, Delete, Properties).

docs.title: Navigating Folders
docs.text:
• Double-click a folder to open it.
  • Use breadcrumb segments to jump to any level.
  • Use the browser Back button to return while preserving selection state.

Typical structure:

Home/
├── assessments/
│   ├── 2024/
│   │   └── 12/
│   ├── 2025/
│   │   └── 12/
│   └── 2026/
│       └── 01/
├── news/
│   └── attachments/
└── profile/

docs.title: Creating Folders
docs.text:
1. Navigate to the desired parent folder.
  2. Click New Folder.
  3. Enter a name (avoid / \ : * ? " < > |).
  4. Click Create.

Results: The folder is created in the current location. You may automatically navigate into it depending on configuration.

Naming tips:

  • ✅ 2025-Season-Reports, Training Materials
  • ❌ Reports/2025, Data:Files, very long names

docs.title: Upload Button
docs.text:
1. Navigate to the destination folder.
  2. Click Upload Files.
  3. Select one or multiple files.
  4. Click Upload.

docs.title: Drag-and-Drop
docs.text:
• Drag files from your computer into the grid to upload.

During upload:

  • A progress bar shows overall and per-file progress.
  • Large files may take longer; Wi-Fi recommended.

Limits and requirements:

  • Typical per-file limit: 10-50 MB (varies by group).
  • Allowed types: Most standard document, image, video, and archive formats.
  • Blocked types: Executables (.exe), certain scripts, or flagged files.

If a name collision occurs:

  • Choose Overwrite, Keep Both (auto-renamed), or Skip.

docs.title: Rename
docs.text:
1. Select a file/folder.
  2. Click Rename.
  3. Edit the name (keep extensions unchanged), then save.

docs.title: Download
docs.text:
• Select a file and click Download.
  • For multiple files, use Download Selected; may create a ZIP.

docs.title: Properties
docs.text: • Open the context menu → Properties to view size, type, dates, uploaded-by, and (if applicable) share link status.

docs.title: Share Links
docs.text:
Share links provide temporary access to a single file without requiring MOS login.

  1. Select one file and click Share.
  2. Choose expiration: 1, 7, or 30 days.
  3. Generate and copy the link.
  4. Send via email or message.

Security:

  • Links are hard to guess and expire automatically.
  • Revocation may require an Owner to intervene.

Best practices:

  • ✅ Use the shortest expiration required.
  • ❌ Avoid posting links publicly.

docs.title: Deleting Items
docs.text:
1. Select one or more files/folders.
  2. Click Delete.
  3. Confirm the permanent deletion.

Deleting folders removes all contents recursively. Consider downloading an archive first if needed.

docs.title: Moving Files and Folders
docs.text:
1. Select items and click Move.
  2. Choose the destination in the folder tree.
  3. Click Move Here.

Notes:

  • You cannot move a folder into itself or its descendants.
  • Conflicts prompt for overwrite, skip, or rename.

docs.title: Best Practices
docs.text:
• Plan a clear and consistent folder structure.
  • Use meaningful file names with dates or versions.
  • Archive older content to reduce clutter.
  • Prefer share links over email attachments.

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text:
• Upload fails: Check size/type limits, try smaller batches, or a different browser; contact an Owner if storage is full.
  • Missing files: Refresh, verify path, clear filters, or confirm permissions.
  • Share link issues: Ensure it hasn’t expired and the file wasn’t moved/deleted.
  • Permission denied: Ask an Owner to adjust your access.

docs.title: Tips
docs.text:
• ✅ Organise by season, project, or assessment.
  • ✅ Use breadcrumbs to jump quickly.
  • ✅ Clean up duplicates and old versions regularly.

docs.title: Related
docs.text:
• Media
  • Admin Group Settings
  • Reporting
  • Assessments

docs.title: Media: View Files from Your Features
docs.text:
Access Level

All users

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
The Media page is a read-only browser for viewing files and media attached to assessments, news articles, and other system features. This is not a file upload area - it shows media that's been attached to items throughout the system such as:

  • Assessment evidence - Photos, videos, or documents attached to your assessments
  • News attachments - Files included with news articles
  • Profile pictures - Member profile images
  • Assessment templates - Documents linked to assessment reviews
  • Other media associated with features

How to Access: Click Library then Media

What You Can Do:

  • Browse media and files in a hierarchical folder structure
  • View file details (name, size, type, date)
  • Download individual files
  • Generate secure share links for files
  • Navigate to related assessments
  • (Administrators) Clean up unused profile images

What You Cannot Do:

  • ❌ Upload new files (attach files directly to the feature instead - assessments, news, etc.)
  • ❌ Create new folders
  • ❌ Delete or rename files
  • ❌ Move files between folders

docs.title: Understanding the Structure
docs.text:
Media appears in the Media browser when:

  1. Files are attached to assessments (evidence, photos, documents)
  2. Files are attached to news articles
  3. Profile pictures are uploaded by users
  4. Content is shared as part of assessment feedback or reviews

These files are organized by feature type and association, not by direct uploads to a "media folder."

docs.title: Navigation
docs.text:
Breadcrumb Bar:

  • Shows your current location (e.g., Home > Assessments > 2024)
  • Click any segment to jump to that level
  • Use Up (⬆️) to go up one level
  • Click Home (🏠) to return to the top

docs.title: Viewing Folders
docs.text:
1. Double-click a folder to open it
  2. Or click the folder name and press Enter
  3. Contents load showing files and subfolders
  4. Breadcrumb updates to show your location

Captured 25 October 2026.

docs.title: Viewing Files
docs.text:
File Information:

  • Name: Full filename with extension (e.g., match-report-2024.pdf)
  • Size: File size in KB, MB, or GB
  • Date Modified: When the file was last updated
  • Type Icon: Visual indicator of file type (📄 document, 🖼️ image, 🎥 video, etc.)

File Types You Might See:

  • Documents: PDF, DOCX, DOC, TXT, RTF
  • Spreadsheets: XLSX, XLS, CSV
  • Presentations: PPTX, PPT
  • Images: JPG, PNG, GIF, BMP, SVG
  • Videos: MP4, AVI, MOV, WMV
  • Archives: ZIP, RAR
  • Others: Various file types your group has attached

Sorting:

  • Click column headers to sort (Name, Size, Date Modified)
  • Click again to reverse order (ascending ↑ / descending ↓)
  • Folders typically appear before files

docs.title: Empty Folders
docs.text:
If a folder shows "No items in this folder":

  • The folder exists but has no files yet
  • No media has been attached to that feature
  • Or you may not have permission to view all content

docs.title: Single File Download
docs.text:
1. Click the file name
  2. Your browser's download dialog appears
  3. Choose save location or accept default (Downloads folder)
  4. Click Save or Download
  5. Result: File downloads to your computer

docs.title: Browser Download Behaviour
docs.text:
• Chrome: Auto-downloads to Downloads folder
  • Firefox: Asks where to save or uses Downloads folder
  • Edge: Auto-downloads or asks, depending on settings
  • Safari: Opens download dialog or saves automatically

For Large Files (over 10 MB):

  • Allow extra time for download to complete
  • Use Wi-Fi rather than mobile data if possible
  • Do not close your browser until download finishes

After Downloading:

  1. Check your browser's Downloads folder
  2. Open the file with appropriate software
  3. The file is a copy; original remains in the Media browser

docs.title: Troubleshooting Downloads
docs.text:
Download button doesn't work:

  1. Refresh the page and try again
  2. Try a different browser
  3. Check if browser pop-up blocker is enabled
  4. Disable browser extensions temporarily

Permission denied error:

  1. Verify you have access to the item (news, assessment, etc.)
  2. Check your group membership
  3. Log out and back in
  4. Contact your administrator if access should be granted

File missing:

  1. File may have been removed
  2. Sharing link may have expired
  3. Contact your administrator

docs.title: Create a Share Link
docs.text:
Share links allow you to provide access to specific files without requiring recipients to sign in.

How to Create:

  1. Select the file you want to share (click once to highlight)
  2. Click the Share button in the toolbar
  3. Share Link Modal opens

Choose Link Expiration:

  • 1 Day: Link expires after 24 hours
  • 7 Days: Link expires after one week (recommended)
  • 30 Days: Link expires after one month
  1. Click Generate Link or Create Share Link
  2. A unique URL is generated
  3. Click Copy to Clipboard or manually copy the URL

docs.title: Sharing the Link
docs.text:
• Paste into email, chat, or message
  • Recipients click the link to download the file
  • No MOS account required (during validity period)
  • Link expires automatically after the chosen period

What Recipients See:

  • Download page with file name and size
  • Download button to get the file
  • Expiration date
  • No access to other files or your library

Security Best Practices:

  • ✅ Use shortest expiration that meets your needs
  • ✅ Only share links with intended recipients
  • ✅ Avoid posting links publicly
  • ✅ Generate new link rather than re-sharing old ones
  • ❌ Don't share links in public forums or social media

docs.title: Revoking Links
docs.text:
If you need to revoke a link before expiration:
