  • Contact your administrator
  • They can manually revoke specific links
  • Link immediately becomes invalid

docs.title: View Assessment Evidence
docs.text:
Some folders in Media contain files linked to assessments:

How to Find:

  1. Navigate to the assessments folder in Media
  2. Find the assessment evidence file
  3. Click View beside the file to open the full assessment with its details and evidence

Captured 25 October 2026. Names and sample records shown are fictional.

What You'll See:

  • Original assessment details
  • Reviewer feedback (if reviewed)
  • All attached media (photos, videos, documents)
  • Rating scales and comments

Downloading Evidence:

  1. Open the assessment
  2. Look for attachment links or download buttons
  3. Click to download the file
  4. Results appear in your Downloads folder

docs.title: Profile Images Cleanup
docs.text:
Access Level

Owner access required for profile image cleanup.

docs.title: Unused Profile Images
docs.text:
Over time, your MOS group may accumulate profile images for users who no longer exist or have changed their profile picture multiple times, leaving orphaned image files.

What This Tool Does:

  • Scans the media library for profile image files
  • Identifies images not currently assigned to any user profile
  • Allows bulk deletion of these orphaned images

Access the Tool:

  1. Navigate to Library → Media
  2. (Admins only) Admin Tools panel appears
  3. Click Profile Images Cleanup or Clean Unused Profile Images

Review Orphaned Images:

  1. A list of unused profile images appears:

    • Image thumbnail
    • File name
    • File size
    • Upload date
    • "Not in use" indicator

  2. Select images to delete (checkboxes)

  3. Or Select All to delete all unused images

Delete Images:

  1. Click Delete Selected or Remove Unused Images
  2. Confirmation prompt appears: "Are you sure? This cannot be undone."
  3. Confirm to permanently delete

Results:

  • Selected images are removed from the media library
  • Storage space is freed
  • No impact on current user profiles (only orphaned files are removed)
  • Success message shows how many images were deleted

When to Use:

  • Storage space is running low
  • Performing regular media library maintenance
  • After bulk user deletions or profile migrations
  • To clean up old test accounts

Caution:

  • ⚠️ Deletion is permanent - images cannot be recovered
  • ⚠️ Ensure images are truly orphaned before deleting
  • ⚠️ If in doubt, do not delete - orphaned images don't cause harm
  • ⚠️ Consider downloading a backup before bulk deleting

Tips:

  • ✅ Run cleanup quarterly or annually as part of maintenance
  • ✅ Review list carefully before bulk delete
  • ✅ Only delete if storage is a concern; orphaned images are harmless
  • ❌ Don't delete images that might be in use elsewhere (linked in news, assessments, etc.)

docs.title: Can't See Expected Files
docs.text:
Problem: Files or folders are missing from the media library

Solutions:

  1. Check Your Location:

    • Verify you're in the correct folder (check breadcrumb)
    • Navigate to parent folder and look for subfolder

  2. Refresh the View:

    • Click Refresh button to reload folder contents
    • Files may have been added since you opened the page

  3. Permissions:

    • You may not have permission to view certain folders or files
    • Contact your administrator if you think you should have access

  4. Subgroup Visibility:

    • Some files may be restricted to specific subgroups
    • Check with administrator about subgroup assignments

  5. Files May Be in Folders (not Media):

    • Media is read-only view; some content may only be in Folders page
    • Try Library → Folders instead

docs.title: Download Doesn't Start
docs.text:
Problem: Clicking download doesn't download the file

Solutions:

  1. Browser Blocked Download:

    • Check browser's download/popup blocker
    • Allow downloads from MOS domain
    • Try again

  2. File Too Large:

    • Large files may time out
    • Try a wired connection or better Wi-Fi
    • Contact admin if file is too large for normal download

  3. Browser Compatibility:

    • Try a different browser (Chrome, Firefox, Edge)
    • Update your current browser to latest version

  4. Network Issues:

    • Check your internet connection
    • Try again later if network is slow

docs.title: Share Link Doesn't Work
docs.text:
Problem: Generated share link shows error or doesn't load

Solutions:

  1. Link Expired:

    • Check expiration date
    • Generate a new link if needed

  2. Link Copied Incorrectly:

    • Ensure entire URL was copied (check for truncation)
    • Re-copy from share modal

  3. Permissions Changed:

    • File may have been deleted or moved
    • Permissions may have been revoked
    • Generate new link

  4. Recipient Issues:

    • Recipient may have network/browser issues
    • Ask them to try different browser or device

docs.title: Tips
docs.text:
For All Users:

  • ✅ Use breadcrumb navigation to jump between folders quickly
  • ✅ Sort by Date Modified to find recent uploads
  • ✅ Generate short-lived share links (1-7 days) for better security
  • ✅ Download files for offline access when needed
  • ✅ Use Folders page for upload/edit operations (Media is read-only)
  • ❌ Don't share sensitive files via public share links

For Administrators:

  • ✅ Regularly clean up unused profile images to free storage
  • ✅ Organise media library with clear folder structure
  • ✅ Review share link expiration settings for your group
  • ✅ Monitor storage usage and advise users to delete old files
  • ❌ Don't delete files without confirming they're truly orphaned

docs.title: Related Pages
docs.text:
• Folders - Full file manager with upload/edit capabilities
  • Share Links - Create and manage secure file sharing links
  • File Downloads - Download files from throughout the system
  • Reporting - Generate reports with media attachments
  • Group Reporting - View group activity reports
  • Admin Group Settings - Configure library settings

docs.title: About Match Official System Licensing
docs.text: Match Official System is an annual subscription service provided by Cortana Design. Associations and organisations purchase annual (or seasonal) licences to use the system, which includes access for all members and features.

docs.title: Pricing
docs.text:
All prices are in Australian Dollars (AUD). Australian organisations have GST (10%) added at checkout.

Subscription cost depends on your organisation's size and the features you select. Pricing is made up of a base subscription plus optional add-ons for additional users, subgroups, and AI features. Annual subscriptions typically range from $500 to $1,500 AUD per year. Current pricing is shown during the signup process and on the Billing page.

Captured 25 October 2026.

docs.title: How Users and Subgroups Are Priced
User Licensing
docs.text:
Users are purchased in blocks of 50

  • Minimum: 50 users
  • Additional blocks can be purchased as needed
  • Covers all members who need access to the system
  • All members with any role count towards this limit

docs.title: Subgroup Licensing
docs.text:
Subgroups are purchased in blocks of 5

  • Minimum: 5 subgroups (or the subscription includes a base allocation)
  • Additional blocks can be purchased for more divisions/regions/teams
  • Each subgroup helps organise members and control feature access
  • Allows targeting of news, resources and assessments

docs.title: Included Features
docs.text:
All features except subgroup enhancements are available with your subscription:

  • ✅ Dashboard and personal workspace
  • ✅ Profile management
  • ✅ News and announcements
  • ✅ Assessments and reviews
  • ✅ Exams and question banks
  • ✅ File storage and library
  • ✅ Media management
  • ✅ Reporting and analytics
  • ✅ User management (Owners only)
  • ✅ Group settings and configuration
  • ✅ Assessment templates
  • ✅ Email notifications

docs.title: Subgroup Enhancements
docs.text:
Subgroup-related features:

  • Create and organise subgroups
  • Target news to specific subgroups
  • Assign users to subgroups
  • Control access based on subgroup membership
  • Organise assessments by subgroup
  • Generate subgroup-specific reports

docs.title: Determining User Count
docs.text:
Count all members who need access:

  • Match officials who create and submit assessments
  • Reviewers who assess and provide feedback
  • Administrators who manage the system
  • Support staff who may need read-only access
  • New members who will join during the subscription period

Plan for growth: purchase additional user blocks if you expect to grow during the subscription year.

docs.title: Determining Subgroup Count
docs.text:
Consider your organisational structure:

  • No subgroups: One flat organisation
  • By region: Regional divisions (e.g. North, South, East, West)
  • By level: Competitive levels (e.g. Professional, Semi‑Professional, Amateur)
  • By sport/code: Different sports within one organisation
  • By committee: Management committees with different roles
  • Hybrid: A mix of different organisational structures

Example: A state-level sporting body with 5 regions might purchase:

  • 150 users (3 blocks of 50)
  • 10 subgroups (2 blocks of 5) for regions and central administration

docs.title: Subscription Management
docs.text: Group owners can manage their subscription directly from the Billing page (Admin > Billing). See Billing for full details.

docs.title: Annual Renewal
docs.text:
• Subscriptions renew automatically each year
  • Your card on file is charged on the renewal date
  • The renewal amount reflects your current plan at the time of renewal

docs.title: Adjusting Capacity
docs.text:
You can increase or decrease user blocks and subgroup blocks at any time from Admin > Billing:

  • Increases are charged immediately, prorated for the remainder of the current billing period
  • Changes take effect straight away

docs.title: Cancellation
docs.text: You can cancel your subscription through the billing portal (Admin > Billing > Open billing portal). Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period.

docs.title: Invoice and Billing
docs.text:
• Subscriptions are billed automatically via Stripe
  • Invoices and payment history are available through the billing portal (Admin > Billing > Open billing portal)
  • For billing enquiries, contact Cortana Design at mos@matchofficialsystem.com

docs.title: Support and Assistance
docs.text:
For questions about your subscription:

  • Contact your association administrator
  • Reach out to Cortana Design directly
  • Check this documentation for feature explanations

docs.title: Small Organisation
docs.text:
50 users

  • Single subscription: ~$500/year
  • All features included
  • May eventually need subgroups as you grow

docs.title: Medium Organisation
docs.text:
100-150 users

  • 3 user blocks (150 users): ~$1,000/year
  • 1 subgroup block (5 subgroups): additional cost
  • Total: ~$1,100-1,200/year

docs.title: Large Organisation
docs.text:
300+ users, complex structure

  • 6+ user blocks (300+ users)
  • 2-3 subgroup blocks (10-15 subgroups)
  • Total: ~$1,400-1,500+/year

docs.title: Standard Features (Included)
docs.text: All features listed under "Included Features" are available with any subscription.

docs.title: Optional/Premium Features
docs.text:
Some organisations may have negotiated:

  • Hosting in other Microsoft Azure regions
  • Dedicated training and onboarding
  • Priority support

Contact Cortana Design to enquire about optional packages.

docs.title: Common Questions
docs.text: For frequently asked questions about licensing, including user limits, subgroups, customisation, and subscription changes, see Frequently Asked Questions.

docs.title: Next Steps
docs.text:
New organisations can sign up and activate a subscription entirely online. See Sign Up Your Organisation for the full walkthrough.

Existing groups manage their subscription from Admin > Billing. See Billing for details.

docs.title: Contact Information
docs.text: For subscription enquiries go to: https://www.cortanadesign.com.au/mos

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Read news articles and announcements from your association or groups you belong to. All articles show the title, author, when they were last updated, and any attachments.

How to Access: Click News

Captured 25 October 2026.

docs.title: Understanding the News Page
docs.text:
News articles appear as cards showing:

  • Association or group name and logo
  • Article title
  • Author name
  • Last updated time
  • Attachments (if any)

Articles display newest first. You only see articles posted to your association and subgroups you're a member of.

docs.title: Wide Content
docs.text:
Some articles contain wide content such as tables, embedded media, or images that are wider than your screen. When content is too wide to display:

  • A horizontal scroll bar appears at the bottom of the article
  • Drag the scroll bar or swipe left and right to view all content
  • The scroll bar is styled for visibility on the page

docs.title: How to Read an Article
docs.text:
1. On the News page, find the article you want to read
  2. Click Read more
  3. Result: The full article opens with complete content and attachments

Captured 25 October 2026. Names and sample text shown are fictional.

docs.title: How to View More Articles
docs.text:
1. Scroll to the bottom of the news list
  2. Click Show more
  3. Result: Additional articles load below

docs.title: How to Download Attachments
docs.text:
1. Open an article by clicking Read more
  2. Look for attachment links at the top of the article
  3. Click the attachment link
  4. Result: The file downloads to your device

docs.title: Related Pages
docs.text:
• Admin: News Management: Create and publish articles as an administrator
  • Home: View recent news on your dashboard

docs.title: Change Your Name
docs.text:
Access Level

All authenticated users

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Update your first name and last name in the Match Official System. When you change your name, your username also updates automatically.

docs.title: How to Access
docs.text: Click My Account then Change Name

docs.title: Before You Start
docs.text:
What Happens To Password Recovery

If you have a secret question and answer configured on your account they will be retained when you change your name. You can continue to use the Forgot Password process as before.

What This Means

  • If you have a secret question and answer: You can continue to use the Forgot Password process.
  • Social (external) login accounts: Accounts managed by an external identity provider may not support secret question/answer recovery — follow the message shown on the Forgot Password page.
  • Administrators can reset passwords: Association administrators can still reset passwords for any account.

docs.title: How to Change Your Name
docs.text:
1. Navigate to My Account then Change Name
  2. The Change Your Name page opens
  3. Enter your new First Name
  4. Enter your new Last Name
  5. Read the information note about password recovery
  6. Click Save Changes
  7. Confirmation message appears
  8. Result: Your name is updated immediately

Captured 25 October 2026.

docs.title: Field Requirements
docs.text:
First Name

  • Required field
  • Must contain only letters, spaces, hyphens and apostrophes
  • First letter of each word is automatically capitalised
  • Examples: John, Mary-Ann, Jean-Pierre

Last Name

  • Required field
  • Must contain only letters, spaces, hyphens and apostrophes
  • First letter of each word is automatically capitalised
  • Examples: Smith, O'Brien, Van Der Berg

Validation

The system automatically:

  • Capitalises the first letter of each word
  • Accepts hyphens in names like Mary-Ann
  • Accepts apostrophes in names like O'Brien
  • Accepts spaces in names like Van Der Berg

docs.title: What Happens When You Change Your Name
docs.text:
Name Updates

  • First name updates in your profile
  • Last name updates in your profile
  • Full name displays as First Last everywhere in the system

Username Updates

  • New username generates automatically
  • Format: firstname.surname
  • All lowercase
  • Removes spaces, hyphens and apostrophes
  • Examples: john.smith, maryann.obrien, jeanpierre.vanderberg

Username Conflicts

If your new username already exists:

  • A number is added to make it unique
  • Format: firstname.surname1, firstname.surname2, etc.
  • You are notified of your new username

Password Recovery

  • If you have a secret question/answer configured it remains available and you can use the Forgot Password process.
  • If you use a social/external login the Forgot Password page will explain how to proceed.
  • Administrators can still reset your password for you.

Email Notification

You receive an email confirming:

  • Your new name
  • Your new username
  • Note: the confirmation email shows your updated information but does not always indicate whether password recovery remains enabled; check your account or contact your administrator if unsure

Session Updates

  • Your name updates immediately in the current session
  • Top right corner shows your new name
  • Username updates for next login

docs.title: Flowchart
docs.text:
Hold "Alt" / "Option" to enable pan & zoom 
flowchart TD
  A[Open Change Name page] --> B[Enter First Name and Last Name]
  B --> C{Are names valid?}
  C -- No --> C1[Show message: use letters, spaces, hyphens, apostrophes]
  C1 --> B
  C -- Yes --> D[Generate new username: firstname.surname]
  D --> D1[Convert to lowercase]
  D1 --> D2[Remove spaces, hyphens, apostrophes]
  D2 --> E{Does this username already exist?}
  E -- No --> F[Use generated username]
  E -- Yes --> G[Add a number to make it unique]
  F --> H[Secret question retained]
  G --> H
  H --> I[Update your profile name]
  I --> J[Send confirmation email]
  J --> K[Update session: top-right name changes]
  K --> L[Result: Name updated immediately]
  L --> M[Next login: use your new username]
  H --> N[If social/external account: follow Forgot Password guidance]

docs.title: After Changing Your Name
docs.text:
Next Login

When you log in next time:

  1. Use your new username
  2. Use your current password (unchanged)
  3. Log in as normal

If You Forget Your Password

  1. Contact your association administrator
  2. They can reset your password for you
  3. You will receive an email with a new temporary password

If You Want to Change Password Recovery Settings

Password recovery cannot be re-enabled after a name change. This is a security measure to protect your account.

docs.title: Example 1: Simple Name Change
docs.text:
Current Name: John Smith Current Username: john.smith

Change to: Jonathan Smith

Result:

  • Name: Jonathan Smith
  • Username: jonathan.smith
  • Email sent confirming the change

docs.title: Example 2: Name Change with Hyphen
docs.text:
Current Name: Mary Smith Current Username: mary.smith

Change to: Mary-Ann Smith

Result:

  • Name: Mary-Ann Smith
  • Username: maryann.smith
  • Email sent confirming the change

docs.title: Example 3: Name Change with Username Conflict
docs.text:
Current Name: John Williams Current Username: john.williams

Change to: John Smith

System Check: john.smith already exists

Result:

  • Name: John Smith
  • Username: john.smith1
  • Email sent confirming the change
  • Message shows your new username includes a number

docs.title: Tips
docs.text:
Before Changing Your Name

  • Make sure you know your current password
  • Consider whether you need the name change
  • Check whether your account uses a social/external login or has a secret question configured; contact your administrator if unsure

After Changing Your Name

  • Write down your new username
  • Test logging out and back in with new username
  • Store your password securely
  • Contact your administrator if you need to reset your password

Password Security

  • Use a strong password you will remember
  • Consider using a password manager
  • Do not share your password
  • Change your password regularly

docs.title: Invalid Name Format
docs.text:
Symptoms

  • Error message when entering name
  • Cannot save changes
  • Message about invalid characters

How to Fix

  1. Check your name contains only letters, spaces, hyphens and apostrophes
  2. Remove any numbers or special characters
  3. Remove extra spaces
  4. Try again

Common Causes

  • Numbers in name field
  • Special characters like brackets or commas
  • Extra spaces at start or end

docs.title: Cannot Save Changes
docs.text:
Symptoms

  • Save button does not work
  • Page does not respond
  • No confirmation message

How to Fix

  1. Check both first name and last name are filled in
  2. Verify names meet format requirements
  3. Refresh the page
  4. Try again
  5. Clear browser cache if problem persists

Common Causes

  • Empty required fields
  • Invalid characters in names
  • Browser cache issues
  • Session expired

docs.title: Did Not Receive Confirmation Email
docs.text:
Symptoms

  • Name changed successfully
  • No email received
  • Cannot confirm new username

How to Fix

  1. Check your spam or junk mail folder
  2. Wait a few minutes for email to arrive
  3. Check email address is correct in your profile
  4. Contact your administrator to confirm your new username

Common Causes

  • Email went to spam folder
  • Email delayed in delivery
  • Incorrect email address on your account

docs.title: Forgot New Username
docs.text:
Symptoms

  • Changed name successfully
  • Cannot remember new username
  • Cannot log in

How to Fix

  1. Check the confirmation email sent when you changed your name
  2. Try firstname.surname format
  3. Try with numbers added if that exists (firstname.surname1)
  4. Contact your administrator to confirm your username

Common Causes

  • Did not note down new username
  • Confirmation email deleted
  • Username had number added due to conflict

docs.title: Related Pages
docs.text:
• Change Password - Update your password
  • Update Profile - Change other profile information
  • Forgot Password - Password recovery information
  • Admin User Management - How administrators manage users

docs.title: Change Password and Security Details
docs.text:
Access Level

All authenticated users. Accounts that use an external sign-in provider manage their password with that provider.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Use this page to change your MOS password and set the security question and answer used for password recovery.

How to access: Select My Account then Change password.

docs.title: Change your password
docs.text:
1. Enter your Current Password if that field appears. MOS may not ask for it when you are setting a temporary password.
  2. Enter your new password in New Password.
  3. Enter it again in Confirm New Password.
  4. Select Change Password.
  5. Result: MOS confirms the change. You can continue using your account; use the new password next time you sign in.

docs.title: Password requirements
docs.text:
Your password must:

  • Be between 8 and 64 characters long.
  • Include at least three of these four character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and symbols.

As you type the confirmation, MOS shows which requirements are met.

docs.title: Set or update your security question
docs.text:
MOS uses your security question and answer in its password-recovery process. Set them before you need to recover your account.

  1. Enter a question in Your Question.
  2. If Your Answer is not already shown, select Update Answer.
  3. Enter the answer and select Save Answer.
  4. Result: MOS confirms that your security details were saved.

If an existing question is shown, you can replace it before saving a new answer.

docs.title: Accounts using an external provider
docs.text: If you sign in through an external provider, MOS does not show the password or security-question controls. Update your password with that provider. See Sign In for the sign-in options available to your account.

docs.title: Forgot your password?
docs.text: If you cannot sign in, use the Forgot Password process. It uses the email address and security answer saved for your account.

docs.title: Related pages
docs.text:
• Update Profile — Manage your profile details and preferences.
  • Update Email Address — Change your primary or secondary email address.
  • Sign In — Sign in to MOS.

docs.title: Profile: Linked Accounts
docs.text:
Access Level

Authenticated Users Only

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Linked accounts allow you to sign into Match Official System using your Microsoft or Google account in addition to your primary credentials. This provides extra convenience and an additional way to access your account if you forget your password.

What you can do:

  • Link your Microsoft account
  • Link your Google account
  • Unlink accounts at any time
  • Log in with any linked account

docs.title: Why Link Social Accounts?
docs.text:
Convenience

  • Sign in with one click using Microsoft or Google
  • No need to remember another password

Account Recovery

  • If you forget your primary password, you can still sign in with a linked social account
  • Provides backup access to your account

Flexibility

  • Switch between login methods depending on your preference
  • Maintain your primary login method while adding alternatives

docs.title: Linking Microsoft Account
docs.text:
1. Navigate to your profile settings

    • Click your name or avatar in the top navigation bar

    • Choose "My Account" from the dropdown menu

      Alternative navigation

      In the My Account section, you can also select Update Profile from the sidebar.

  2. Find the Linked Accounts section

    • Scroll to "Linked Accounts" or "Connected Accounts"

  3. Click "Link Microsoft Account"

    • The button appears under the Microsoft Account section
    • You'll be redirected to Microsoft's login page

  4. Sign in with your Microsoft account

    • Enter your Microsoft email address
    • Enter your Microsoft password
    • Complete any security verification if requested

  5. Return and confirm

    • You'll be automatically returned to your profile
    • You'll see a confirmation message: "Your Microsoft account has been linked successfully"
    • Microsoft Account now appears as "Linked" in your profile

docs.title: Linking Google Account
docs.text:
The process is the same as Microsoft:

  1. Go to your profile settings (top right of any page)
  2. Find the Linked Accounts section
  3. Click "Link Google Account"
  4. Sign in with your Google account (email and password)
  5. You'll see a confirmation: "Your Google account has been linked successfully"

What Happens When You Link

When you link an account, the system creates a secure connection between your Match Official System account and your Microsoft/Google account. The connection allows you to sign in using either method.

docs.title: How to Log In With a Linked Account
docs.text:
After you've linked an account, you can log in using it:

  1. Go to the Match Official System login page

  2. Instead of entering your email and password, look for:

    • "Sign in with Microsoft" button
    • "Sign in with Google" button

  3. Click the social login button

    • You'll be redirected to Microsoft or Google

    • If you're already signed into Microsoft/Google in your browser.

      Seamless Login

      If you're already logged into your Microsoft or Google account in your browser, you might not need to enter your password again. Just click the social login button and you'll be signed in automatically.

  4. You're signed in!

    • The system recognises your social account is linked to your profile
    • Your session is established with your Match Official System account
    • You have full access with your linked account

docs.title: Unlink Microsoft or Google Account
docs.text:
1. Go to your profile settings

    • Click your name or avatar in the top right
    • Select "My Account"

  2. Find the Linked Accounts section

    • Scroll to your linked accounts
    • Find the account you want to unlink

  3. Click the "Unlink" button

    • The "Unlink" button appears next to each linked account

  4. Confirm in the popup

    • A confirmation window appears: "Are you sure you want to unlink your [Provider] account?"
    • Click "Unlink" to confirm

  5. Confirmation message

    • You'll see: "Your [Provider] account has been unlinked successfully"
    • The account no longer appears as linked in your profile

After Unlinking

After unlinking an account, you will no longer be able to sign in using that social account. You'll need to use your primary password to access Match Official System. Consider changing your password if you may forget it.

docs.title: What Gets Connected?
docs.text:
When you link an account, the system securely connects:

  • Your Match Official System account (your email, password, and user data)
  • Your Microsoft or Google identity (your social account email and ID)

The connection is stored securely in the system's database.

docs.title: Multiple Linked Accounts
docs.text:
You can link both Microsoft and Google accounts to the same Match Official System account:

Your Match Official System Account
    ├─ Primary: Email + Password
    ├─ Linked: Microsoft Account
    └─ Linked: Google Account

You can sign in using any of these three methods.

docs.title: Are My Passwords Shared?
docs.text:
No. Your Match Official System password and your Microsoft/Google passwords are completely separate:

  • Linking does not require you to share your primary password with Microsoft or Google
  • Linking does not give Microsoft or Google access to your Match Official System data
  • Only the system administrator can see the connection exists

docs.title: Can Someone Else Link My Account?
docs.text:
No. Linking requires you to be:

  1. Already signed into your Match Official System account
  2. Able to authenticate with your Microsoft or Google account

No one else can link accounts on your behalf.

docs.title: "Linking succeeds but I can't sign in with that account"
docs.text:
What this means: The account appears as linked in your profile, but the login button doesn't work.

How to fix it:

  1. Try signing out completely and clearing your browser cache
  2. Go back to the login page
  3. Click the social login button again
  4. If the issue persists, contact your system administrator

docs.title: "The system says my social account is already linked"
docs.text:
What this means: You tried to link a social account that's already connected to a different Match Official System account.

How to fix it:

  1. You can only link a social account once per system
  2. If you have multiple accounts, you'll need to decide which one to use
  3. Contact your system administrator if you need to consolidate accounts

docs.title: "I unlinked my account but I still can't log in"
docs.text:
What this means: After unlinking, the social login option is no longer available for you.

How to fix it:

  1. Use your primary email and password to sign in instead
  2. If you forgot your password, use the forgot password flow to reset it
  3. You can link the social account again anytime

docs.title: "Sign in with [Provider] button isn't working"
docs.text:
What this means: The social login method might be temporarily unavailable, or the account isn't properly linked.

How to fix it:

  1. Try refreshing the page
  2. Clear your browser cookies and cache
  3. Make sure you're using the same email address for your social account as your Match Official System account
  4. Try unlinking and relinking the account
  5. Contact your system administrator if the issue continues

docs.title: "I can't find the Linked Accounts section"
docs.text:
Where to look:

  1. Click your name or profile icon in the top navigation
  2. Select "Profile" or "Profile Settings"
  3. Look for a section labeled "Linked Accounts," "Connected Accounts," or "Social Accounts"
  4. It should be on the main profile page or in a security/settings tab

docs.title: Best Practices
docs.text:
• Choose strong passwords: Your Microsoft and Google passwords should be strong and unique
  • Enable two-factor authentication: Enable 2FA on your Microsoft and Google accounts for extra security
  • Review linked accounts regularly: Periodically check your linked accounts to ensure they're still needed
  • Unlink accounts you don't use: Remove social accounts if you're no longer using them to sign in

docs.title: If You're Concerned About Security
docs.text:
• Change your password: If you suspect someone accessed your account, change your password
  • Unlink all accounts: If you're concerned about social account linking, unlink all accounts and use only your primary password
  • Contact your administrator: Report any suspicious activity to your system administrator

docs.title: FAQ
docs.text:
Q: Can I link multiple social accounts? A: Yes. You can link both your Microsoft account and your Google account to the same Match Official System account.

Q: If I forget my Microsoft/Google password, can I still access Match Official System? A: Yes. You can still sign in using your primary email and password. Then you can use the forgot password flow if needed.

Q: Can I link the same social account to multiple Match Official System accounts? A: No. Each social account can only be linked to one Match Official System account.

Q: Does linking an account change my password? A: No. Your primary password remains unchanged. Linking just adds another way to sign in.

Q: What happens if I delete my Microsoft/Google account? A: You'll no longer be able to sign in using that social provider. You can still use your primary password to access Match Official System.

Q: Is my account secure if I link social accounts? A: Yes. Linking is secure and only requires authentication from both accounts. Your data remains protected.

Q: Can I link accounts with different email addresses? A: Your linked social account should ideally use the same email address as your Match Official System account, though the system will allow different emails. Emails will however be sent only to your primary B2C local account.

Q: How do I know which accounts are linked? A: Go to your Profile Settings and look at the Linked Accounts section. It shows all currently linked accounts.

docs.title: Next Steps
docs.text:
• Change Your Password - Update your primary password
  • Update Your Profile - Manage your profile information
  • Change Your Name - Update your name in the system
  • Sign In to Your Account - Learn about login options
  • Recover Your Password - Reset your password if you forget it

docs.title: Linking Workflow
docs.text:
Hold "Alt" / "Option" to enable pan & zoom 
flowchart TD
    Start([User clicks Link Account button]) --> Navigate[Redirect to Microsoft/Google login]
    Navigate --> SocialAuth{Already signed in to social account?}
    SocialAuth -->|Yes| Consent[Review permissions]
    SocialAuth -->|No| SocialLogin[Enter email and password]
    SocialLogin --> Consent
    Consent --> Approve{Approve connection?}
    Approve -->|Cancel| CancelFlow[Return to profile]
    CancelFlow --> ShowError[Show cancellation message]
    Approve -->|Yes| Callback[Return to MOS with auth code]
    Callback --> CheckExisting{Social account already linked?}
    CheckExisting -->|Yes| BlockLink[Block linking attempt]
    BlockLink --> ErrorMsg[Error: Account already linked]
    CheckExisting -->|No| ValidateUser{User logged into MOS?}
    ValidateUser -->|No| ErrorAuth[Error: Must be logged in]
    ValidateUser -->|Yes| SaveLink[Save link to database]
    SaveLink --> UpdateDisplay[Update social account display name]
    UpdateDisplay --> Success[Redirect with success message]
    Success --> ShowSuccess[Show: Account linked successfully]
    ShowSuccess --> RefreshUI[Show Unlink button, hide Link button]

docs.title: Unlinking Workflow
docs.text:
Hold "Alt" / "Option" to enable pan & zoom 
flowchart TD
    Start([User clicks Unlink Account button]) --> Modal[Show confirmation modal]
    Modal --> Confirm{User confirms?}
    Confirm -->|Cancel| CloseModal[Close modal, no change]
    Confirm -->|Unlink| RemoveDB[Delete record from database]
    RemoveDB --> DeleteB2C[Delete social B2C user object]
    DeleteB2C --> CheckSuccess{Successfully removed?}
    CheckSuccess -->|No| ShowError[Show error message]
    CheckSuccess -->|Yes| Redirect[Redirect to profile page]
    Redirect --> ShowSuccess[Show: Account unlinked successfully]
    ShowSuccess --> RefreshUI[Show Link button, hide Unlink button]

docs.title: Social Login Sequence
docs.text:
Hold "Alt" / "Option" to enable pan & zoom 
sequenceDiagram
    actor User
    participant Browser
    participant Social as Microsoft/Google
    participant MOS as MOS System
    participant DB as Database

    User->>Browser: Click "Sign in with Microsoft/Google"
    Browser->>MOS: Request social login
    MOS->>Social: Redirect to social provider
    Social->>User: Show login page

    alt Already signed in
        Social->>Social: Use existing session
    else Not signed in
        User->>Social: Enter credentials
        Social->>Social: Authenticate user
    end

    Social->>Browser: Return with auth code
    Browser->>MOS: Send auth code
    MOS->>Social: Exchange code for tokens
    Social->>MOS: Return tokens with social objectId
    MOS->>MOS: Extract social objectId from token

    MOS->>DB: Check if social objectId is linked

    alt Social account not linked
        DB->>MOS: No record found
        MOS->>Browser: Reject sign-in
        Browser->>User: Error: Account not linked
    else Social account is linked
        DB->>MOS: Return local account objectId
        MOS->>DB: Load user session with local objectId
        DB->>MOS: User profile data
        MOS->>MOS: Create authentication session
        MOS->>Browser: Redirect to dashboard
        Browser->>User: Successfully signed in
    end

docs.title: Profile Management
docs.text:
Your profile page brings together your photo, group memberships, personal information, contact details, appearance, notifications and account activity.

Open My Account → Update Profile to manage these details. The page uses tabs:

  • Personal — edit your About me text.
  • Contact — update your address and phone numbers.
  • Group Info — complete additional fields if your association has configured them. The available fields vary by group.
  • Appearance — choose a theme.
  • Notifications — manage the email and device notification settings available to you.
  • Activity — review account activity.

Use Update image below your profile photo to upload a new photo, or Remove image to remove it when available.

Captured 25 October 2026.

For detailed steps, see Update Profile. You can also change your name or update your email address.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Search for a member by name from the page header. Open the matching member's profile or, depending on your access, continue to an assessment or another available action.

docs.title: Search from the page header
docs.text:
Captured 25 October 2026. The member information shown is fictional.

  1. Enter a member's name in the Search users... box at the top of the page.
  2. When a matching member appears in the result panel, choose View Profile or another action available to you. Assessment buttons appear together on the Assessments row. If you do not have Owner access, the Admin row explains that user editing requires Owner access.
  3. To open the full results page for the search term, select the search icon or View all results at the bottom of the result panel.

docs.title: Search results
docs.text:
The results page lists members in your group whose name matches the search term. Select a member's available action to open their profile or continue with another task. The information shown in a result depends on your group's sharing settings. Contact details and profile information may be hidden.

If you cannot find a member, check the spelling or search with a shorter part of their name. Search results only include members available in your group.

docs.title: Related pages
docs.text:
• User Management: Find, edit, and manage members in your organisation.
  • Update Profile: Change your own profile details and sharing preferences.

docs.title: Update Email Address
docs.text:
Access Level

All authenticated users

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Change your primary email address or add a secondary email for notifications. Your primary email is used for login and account correspondence.

How to Access: Click My Account then Update email address

Important

Changing your primary email requires your current password to authorise the change. Secondary emails are optional and don't require a password.

docs.title: Change Your Primary Email Address
docs.text:
Your primary email is used for:

  • Logging into the system
  • Receiving password reset emails
  • Important account notifications
  • System correspondence

docs.title: Steps to Change Primary Email
docs.text:
1. Click My Account → Update email address
  2. Your current email displays in the "Current email address" field
  3. Enter your new email in the New email address field
  4. Click Continue
  5. If the email is available, you'll see a password confirmation section
  6. Enter your current password to authorise the change
  7. Click Update
  8. Result: "Email address has been changed to [new email]"

Captured 25 October 2026.

MOS checks whether the new address is available. If it is, continue to the password confirmation step and follow the on-screen instructions to complete the change.

docs.title: Form Fields
docs.text:
Current email address

  • Shows your existing email (read-only)
  • Cannot be changed directly

New email address (required)

  • Enter your new email address
  • Must be in valid email format (example@domain.com)
  • Cannot be an email already used by another account

Continue button

  • Submits your new email address
  • Checks if the email is available
  • Shows password confirmation if available

Current Password (required when changing)

  • You must enter your current password to authorise the change
  • Required for security

Update button

  • Confirms the email change
  • Uses your password to update the system

docs.title: Email Format Rules
docs.text:
Your email must follow standard format:

Valid Examples:

  • firstname.lastname@company.com
  • user@gmail.com
  • first_last@organization.org

Invalid Examples:

  • notanemail ❌ (no @ symbol)
  • user @company.com ❌ (space in address)
  • missing@domain ❌ (no extension)

docs.title: Add or Update Secondary Email
docs.text: A secondary email receives the same notifications as your primary email but cannot be used for login.

docs.title: Add Secondary Email
docs.text:
1. Scroll to the Update your secondary email address section
  2. Enter an email address in the field
  3. Click Save
  4. Result: "Secondary email address updated"

Note

Secondary email setup is immediate - no password or verification required.

docs.title: Remove Secondary Email
docs.text:
1. In the Update your secondary email address section, clear the field completely
  2. Click Save
  3. Result: Secondary email is removed from your account

docs.title: Secondary Email Rules
docs.text:
• Optional - you don't have to add one
  • Cannot be used for login
  • Receives duplicate notifications of your primary email
  • Must be in valid email format if you add one

docs.title: The email address is already in use
docs.text:
What This Means: Another account is already using this email address.

How to Fix: 1. Use a different email address 2. If you have multiple accounts, use separate emails for each 3. Contact your administrator if the email should be yours

docs.title: Error: "Not a valid email address"
docs.text:
What This Means: The email format is incorrect.

How to Fix: 1. Make sure your email has an @ symbol 2. Include the domain (gmail.com, company.org, etc.) 3. Check for typos 4. Don't include spaces

Format: firstname.lastname@example.com

docs.title: Error: "Existing password is not correct"
docs.text:
What This Means: The password you entered doesn't match your account password.

How to Fix: 1. Make sure Caps Lock is off 2. Re-enter your password carefully 3. Try again 4. If you forgot your password, click Forgot password to reset it before trying to change your email

docs.title: What Happens After You Change Your Email
docs.text:
After you successfully change your primary email:

  1. Confirmation emails are sent to both your old and new email addresses
  2. Next login - You can use your new email to log in
  3. Password reset emails will now go to your new address
  4. System notifications will go to your new email
  5. Your secondary email (if you have one) will still receive duplicate notifications

docs.title: Email Change Workflow Diagram
docs.text:
Hold "Alt" / "Option" to enable pan & zoom 
graph TD
    A["1. Go to<br/>My Account"] --> B["2. Click<br/>Update email"]
    B --> C["3. Enter new<br/>email address"]
    C --> D["4. Click<br/>Continue"]
    D --> E{Email<br/>available?}
    E -->|No| F["Error:<br/>Email exists"]
    F --> C
    E -->|Yes| G["Show password<br/>confirmation"]
    G --> H["5. Enter current<br/>password"]
    H --> I["6. Click<br/>Update"]
    I --> J{Password<br/>correct?}
    J -->|No| K["Error:<br/>Wrong password"]
    K --> H
    J -->|Yes| L["✓ Email updated"]
    L --> M["Confirmation<br/>emails sent"]

docs.title: Will my account be locked during the change?
docs.text: No. You stay logged in the whole time. The change happens immediately after you verify your password.

docs.title: Can I use my new email to log in right away?
docs.text: Yes. After the change is complete, you can use your new email address to log in on your next visit.

docs.title: Do confirmation emails actually get sent?
docs.text: Yes. Your old email and new email both receive a confirmation that the change was made. This helps you know if someone else tried to change your email.

docs.title: What if I add a secondary email and then change my primary email?
docs.text: Your secondary email remains and continues to receive notifications. You can change either one at any time independently.

docs.title: Can I use the same email for primary and secondary?
docs.text: No. You cannot duplicate your primary email as a secondary email.

docs.title: Best Practices
docs.text:
Email Management:

  • ✅ Use an email address you check regularly
  • ✅ Keep your password secure (don't share it)
  • ✅ Update your email before old account closes
  • ✅ Remove secondary email if you stop using it

Security:

  • ✅ Remember your current password before changing email
  • ✅ Verify both confirmation emails were received
  • ✅ Don't share your email login credentials
  • ✅ Use a strong password

docs.title: Related Pages
docs.text:
• Change Password - Update your account password
  • Update Profile - Change personal information
  • Profile Management - Manage all account settings
  • Forgot Password - Reset your password

docs.title: Update Profile: Manage Your Personal Information
docs.text:
Access Level

All authenticated users

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Use the tabs to manage your About Me text, contact details, any group-required information, theme, notification settings, and account activity.

How to Access: Click My Account then Update Profile

docs.title: Page Sections
docs.text:
The Update Profile page is organised into tabs at the top. Click each tab to navigate between different areas:

  1. Personal — About me and general profile information
  2. Contact — Address and phone numbers
  3. Group Info — Group-required information (shown only if your group has defined custom fields)
  4. Appearance — Theme. Profile photo controls are above the tabs.
  5. Notifications — Email notification settings
  6. Activity — Event log and account history

docs.title: Personal Tab
docs.text: Add information about yourself that you choose to share with other members.

docs.title: How to Update About Me
docs.text:
1. Click the Personal tab
  2. Scroll to the About Me section
  3. Click in the text editor
  4. Type or paste your information
  5. Use the formatting toolbar to:
    • Bold, Italic, or Underline text
    • Add bullet points or numbered lists
    • Insert links
    • Change text alignment
  6. Click Save
  7. Confirmation: "About me saved"

What to Include:

  • Your role or position
  • Experience or qualifications
  • Interests or specializations
  • Anything you'd like colleagues to know

Tips:

  • ✅ Keep it professional
  • ✅ Update regularly
  • ✅ Be concise (a few paragraphs)
  • ✅ Proofread before saving

docs.title: Use AI Rewrite for About Me
docs.text:
When your group has AI features enabled and your role has AI Rewrite access, the About Me editor shows a purple AI Rewrite button.

  1. Write your profile text.
  2. Select a passage to rewrite only that passage, or leave the text unselected to rewrite all About Me text.
  3. Click AI Rewrite.
  4. Check that the result is accurate and still sounds like you.
  5. Make any changes, then click Save.

AI Rewrite does not save your profile automatically. See AI Features for access settings and troubleshooting.

docs.title: Contact Tab
docs.text:
Update your address and phone numbers.

Captured 25 October 2026. The sample contact details are fictional.

docs.title: How to Update Your Address
docs.text:
The address field uses Google Places search to find and save your address. The system stores your address as a single formatted line.

  1. Click the Contact tab
  2. Scroll to the Address section
  3. Click in the Search Address field
  4. Start typing your address (include street number and street name for best results)
  5. A dropdown list of matching addresses appears
  6. Click to select the correct address from the suggestions
  7. The selected address appears in the Current Address field
  8. Scroll down and click Save
  9. Confirmation: "Address details updated"

Example address:

123 Main Street, Springfield VIC 3000, Australia

docs.title: Address Tips
docs.text:
• Type the full address including street number
  • Select from the dropdown suggestions; typing freely won't work
  • The Current Address field shows your saved address (read-only)
  • Use standard address format for best search results
  • Include suburb and postcode if the street isn't found

docs.title: How to Update Phone Numbers
docs.text:
1. In the Contact tab, scroll to the Phone Numbers section
  2. Enter or update:
    • Phone Number — Main contact number
    • Work Number — Business number
    • Secondary Number — Additional/mobile number
  3. Click Save
  4. Confirmation: "Phone numbers updated"

Phone Number Format:

  • Can include: numbers, spaces, dashes, plus signs
  • Include country code for international numbers
  • Examples:
    • +61 3 9123 4567 (international)
    • (03) 9123 4567 (local)
    • 0412 345 678 (mobile)

Tips:

  • ✅ Include area code
  • ✅ Use consistent formatting
  • ✅ Add country code if international
  • ✅ Test your number after saving

docs.title: Profile Photo
docs.text:
The photo controls appear above the profile tabs.

Captured 25 October 2026. The profile shown is fictional.

docs.title: Upload a Profile Photo
docs.text:
1. Click Update image below your current photo.
  2. Click Choose image and select a JPG, PNG, GIF or WebP file.
  3. Drag the image to position it and adjust the square crop.
  4. Click Crop & Upload.
  5. The cropped photo is saved and shown on your profile.

docs.title: Remove a Profile Photo
docs.text:
1. Click Remove image below your photo.
  2. Confirm the removal when prompted.
  3. MOS removes the photo and displays the default profile image.

docs.title: How to Change Your Theme
docs.text:
The theme changes the colour scheme and appearance of your interface. Available themes include light colour schemes and dark mode.

  1. In the Appearance tab, scroll to the Theme section
  2. Click the theme you want
  3. Result: The interface changes immediately to your selected theme

Captured 25 October 2026.

Colour Schemes:

  • Light themes use bright backgrounds with dark text
  • Dark mode uses dark backgrounds with light text for reduced eye strain
  • Names and exact colours may vary by configuration

Dark Mode:

If your organisation has dark mode available, you can enable it by selecting the dark theme. Dark mode is useful for:

  • ✅ Reducing eye strain in low-light environments
  • ✅ Decreasing screen brightness at night
  • ✅ Personal preference for darker interfaces

For a quick switch, click Dark in the top navigation. The control changes to Light when dark mode is active.

Screenshot captured 25 October 2026.

docs.title: Group Information Tab
docs.text:
Fill in additional profile information that your group requires.

Note

This tab only appears if your group has defined custom profile fields. If you don't see this tab, your group hasn't configured any group-specific fields yet.

docs.title: How to Complete Group Information
docs.text:
Your group may ask you to provide additional information in the Group Information tab. This might include emergency contact details, work with children checks, medical information, or other custom fields defined by your group administration.

  1. Click the Group Info tab
  2. You see a list of fields your group requires
  3. For each field:
    • Read the field label and category (shown in parentheses)
    • Enter or select the requested information
    • If marked with a red asterisk (*), the field is required
  4. Click Save
  5. Confirmation: "Profile information saved"

docs.title: Understanding Field Types
docs.text:
Depending on how your group configured the fields, you might see different input types:

Text field — Type a single line of text (e.g., "Senior Coach")

Number field — Enter a numeric value only

Date field — Click and select a date from the calendar

Long text area — Type multiple lines of text (e.g., allergies or medical information)

Dropdown — Click and select from a list of options provided by your group

Checkbox — Check the box if the item applies to you

docs.title: Field Categories
docs.text:
Your group categories information logically. Common categories include:

  • Personal — General personal details
  • Emergency Contact — Next of kin and emergency contact information
  • Identification — Government IDs, working with children checks
  • Employment — Job title, employer, qualifications
  • Medical — Allergies, medical conditions
  • Other — Miscellaneous fields

docs.title: Tips for Group Fields
docs.text:
• ✅ Provide accurate information
  • ✅ If a field is required, you cannot save your profile without it
  • ✅ Update these fields if your information changes
  • ✅ Your group may use this information for uniforms, safety alerts, or communication

docs.title: Notifications Tab
docs.text: Manage how you receive notifications from the system.

docs.title: Email Preferences
docs.text:
Control whether you want to receive automated emails from MOS.

General Emails

  1. Click the Notifications tab
  2. Under General emails, you see the option:
    • "Unsubscribe from MOS automated emails (e.g. Diary reviewed, diary viewed emails)"
  3. Check the box to unsubscribe
  4. Uncheck the box to receive these emails
  5. Click Save preferences

Manual licence expiry notices

Group owners can unsubscribe from licence expiry emails for manually billed groups. MOS sends reminders 90, 60, and 30 days before expiry, then sends a notice 7 days after expiry with the scheduled data deletion date. The general automated-email opt-out also stops these notices.

Appointment Emails

Your group may also allow you to control appointment notifications:

  • "Email me when I am assigned, updated, or removed from an appointment"
  • "Email me appointment reminders and response deadline notices"

Check or uncheck these options based on your preference, then click Save preferences.

docs.title: How to Change Notification Settings
docs.text:
1. Click the Notifications tab
  2. Scroll to the Email Preferences section
  3. Check or uncheck the boxes for notifications you want
  4. Click Save preferences
  5. Confirmation: "Notification preferences saved"

Captured 25 October 2026.

docs.title: Activity Tab
docs.text:
View a history of your account activity and logins.

Captured 25 October 2026.

What the Event Log Shows:

  • Login times and dates
  • Profile changes
  • Password changes
  • Email updates
  • Other account activity

docs.title: How to View Your Event Log
docs.text:
1. Click the Activity tab
  2. You see a table with your recent events
  3. Use the page numbers at the bottom to move between pages
  4. Use the Show login events toggle to include or exclude login records
  5. Information shown:
    • Event name
    • Date and time

Why Check Your Event Log:

  • ✅ Verify your recent activity
  • ✅ Check for unauthorized access
  • ✅ Review when you last logged in
  • ✅ See history of profile changes

Security Tip: If you see logins you don't recognise, change your password immediately and contact an administrator.

docs.title: Account Deletion
docs.text: Warning: This is a permanent action that cannot be undone.

docs.title: How to Delete Your Account
docs.text:
1. If the Delete my account action is available below your profile photo, open it.
  2. Read the confirmation message, which explains that deleting your account and its data is irreversible.
  3. Click Delete my account and all its data to confirm.
  4. MOS deletes the account and logs you out.

What Happens When You Delete:

  • All your personal information is removed
  • Your access to the system is revoked
  • Your profile is no longer visible to others
  • This action is permanent and cannot be reversed

Before Deleting:

  • ✅ Consider if you really want to leave
  • ✅ Download any important information
  • ✅ Inform administrators if required
  • ✅ Contact support if you're having issues instead

docs.title: Updating Multiple Tabs
docs.text:
1. Click a tab to make changes
  2. Update the information you want to change
  3. Click Save (each tab saves independently)
  4. Confirmation: You'll see a success message
  5. Move to the next tab and repeat as needed

docs.title: Viewing and Updating Your Profile Picture
docs.text:
1. Click the Appearance tab
  2. Scroll to the Profile Picture section
  3. To upload: Click Choose File, select an image, then wait for it to upload
  4. To remove: Click Remove Image and confirm
  5. Check the Appearance tab to see your new picture immediately

docs.title: Updating Emergency Contact Information
docs.text:
If your group requires emergency contact details via custom fields:

  1. Click the Group Info tab
  2. Look for fields in the Emergency Contact category
  3. Enter your emergency contact's name and phone number
  4. Click Save
  5. Your information is stored securely

docs.title: Changing Your Address
docs.text:
1. Click the Contact tab
  2. Use the address search to find and select your address
  3. Confirm it appears in the Current Address field
  4. Click Save
  5. Confirmation: "Address details updated"

docs.title: Profile Picture Won't Upload
docs.text:
Possible Causes:

  • File too large
  • Wrong file format
  • Internet connection issue

How to Fix:

  1. Check file is JPG, PNG, or GIF
  2. Reduce image size if over 5 MB
  3. Try a different photo
  4. Check internet connection
  5. Try a different browser
  6. Contact support if problem persists

docs.title: Address Not Saving
docs.text:
How to Fix:

  1. Make sure you selected an address from the dropdown suggestions
  2. Confirm it appears in the Current Address field
  3. Click Save again
  4. Refresh the page and retry

docs.title: "Invalid phone number" Error
docs.text:
How to Fix:

  1. Remove any letters from phone number
  2. Only use: numbers, spaces, dashes, and +
  3. Check format: (03) 9123 4567 or +61 3 9123 4567
  4. Remove any special characters
  5. Ensure you have the correct area code

docs.title: Changes Not Appearing
docs.text:
What to Try:

  1. Refresh the page to see updates
  2. Log out and log back in
  3. Clear browser cache
  4. Try a different browser
  5. Contact support if changes consistently don't save

docs.title: Theme Won't Change
docs.text:
How to Fix:

  1. Click directly on the theme image
  2. Wait a moment for the change to apply
  3. Refresh the page
  4. Clear browser cache
  5. Try selecting a different theme first, then your preferred one

docs.title: Tab or Section Not Visible
docs.text:
Symptoms

  • You don't see the Group Info tab
  • A section doesn't appear in a tab

How to Fix

  1. Refresh the page — tabs may not load on first visit
  2. Log out and log back in
  3. Check with your group administrator — they may not have defined custom fields yet
  4. Verify you're a member of the group

docs.title: Profile Picture
docs.text:
• ✅ Use a professional, clear photo
  • ✅ Update if your appearance changes significantly
  • ✅ Keep file size reasonable (under 2 MB ideal)
  • ✅ Use a square image for best results

docs.title: Contact Information
docs.text:
• ✅ Keep your email and phone up to date
  • ✅ Use an email address you check regularly
  • ✅ Include area codes in phone numbers
  • ✅ Update immediately if contact details change

docs.title: Address
docs.text:
• ✅ Use the address search and select the correct suggestion
  • ✅ Double-check the saved address text
  • ✅ Update as soon as your address changes

docs.title: Group Information Fields
docs.text:
• ✅ Provide accurate, up-to-date information
  • ✅ Complete required fields (marked with *)
  • ✅ Update fields if your information changes
  • ✅ Ask your administrator if you're unsure what a field is for

docs.title: Security

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
The MOS signup wizard lets you register a brand new organisation and activate a subscription entirely online — no need to contact us first. The process takes around five minutes. You will choose your plan, create an account, and complete payment through Stripe's secure checkout. Your group is activated automatically once payment is set up.

All prices are in Australian Dollars (AUD). A 30-day free trial is included — your card is captured during signup but you will not be charged until the trial ends. You can cancel any time during the trial period.

docs.title: How to Access
docs.text:
The signup wizard is publicly accessible — you do not need an existing MOS account to start.

  1. Go to https://www.cortanadesign.com.au/mos
  2. Follow the instructions at the bottom of this page.

docs.title: Before You Start
docs.text:
• You will need a valid email address that will become the owner account for your group
  • You will need a credit or debit card for Stripe checkout (not charged until after the 30-day trial)
  • Choose a short name (3–10 characters) for your organisation — this must be unique across all MOS groups and cannot be changed after signup
  • If your organisation is based in Australia, GST (10%) will be added at checkout on top of all prices shown

docs.title: Step 1 — Your Email
docs.text:
The first step collects the email address for your owner account.

Fields

Field Required Notes Email address Yes This becomes the sign-in address for the group owner. Enter the address you want to use as your administrator login.

Steps

  1. Enter your email address in the Email address field
  2. Click Next

Tip

If your organisation already has a MOS group, click Already have a group? Sign in instead of continuing with signup.

docs.title: Step 2 — Your Group
docs.text:
This step captures the details that identify your organisation within MOS.

Fields

Field Required Notes Association full name Yes The full official name of your organisation as it will appear to users — e.g. Football Victoria Short name Yes A 3–10 character code used throughout the system to identify your group — e.g. FTBVIC. Must be unique across all MOS organisations. Sport Yes The primary sport your organisation manages officials for — e.g. Football Country Yes The country your organisation is based in. Begin typing to select from the list.

Steps

  1. Enter your organisation's full official name in Association full name
  2. Enter a short code in Short name (3–10 characters, letters and numbers only)
  3. Enter the sport in Sport
  4. Start typing your country in Country and select it from the suggestions
  5. Click Next

The system checks whether your chosen short name is already taken. If it is, an error message appears and you must choose a different one before continuing.

Tip

Choose a short name that is easy to recognise but distinct. For example, a national football association might use NFLA rather than just NFA, which is more likely to already be in use.

docs.title: Step 3 — Your Plan
docs.text: This step lets you choose the capacity for your subscription. A trial banner at the top reminds you that no charge applies today.

docs.title: Plan components
docs.text:
Component Description User licenses Priced in blocks of 50 users. Select the number of blocks that covers your expected membership size. Subgroups Optional. Priced in blocks of 5 subgroups. Subgroups let you divide your organisation into regions, panels, competitions, or divisions. Set to 0 if you do not need subgroups. AI features Optional add-on. Enables AI-assisted text rewriting, official summaries, review context, season review drafts, Trainer, and source-grounded exam question drafting.

The price summary below the fields updates automatically as you change your selections. It shows:

  • A one-time Setup fee (charged in your first payment)
  • Base subscription (annual)
  • User licenses cost based on your selected blocks
  • Subgroup cost if you selected subgroup blocks
  • AI features cost if enabled
  • Year 1 total (including the setup fee)
  • Year 2+ renewal price (setup fee not repeated)

Australian organisations see prices listed as ex GST, with a note that GST (10%) is added at checkout.

Steps

  1. In User licenses, enter the number of blocks you need (1 block = 50 users)
  2. In Subgroups, enter the number of blocks you need, or leave it at 0
  3. Toggle AI features on or off
  4. Review the price summary
  5. Click Next

Tip

Start with the minimum number of blocks that covers your current membership. You can increase your capacity at any time from the Billing page after your group is active.

Tip

If you need custom pricing — for example, for a very large organisation (corporate body) or a special arrangement — contact Cortana Design at mos@matchofficialsystem.com before completing signup.

docs.title: Step 4 — Review and Confirm
docs.text:
The final wizard step shows a summary of everything you have entered so you can check it before proceeding.

Review summary includes

  • Email address
  • Association full name and short name
  • Sport and country
  • User capacity
  • Subgroup capacity (if selected)
  • AI features (yes or no)
  • Year 1 total and trial notice

Steps

  1. Read through the summary carefully
  2. If anything is incorrect, click Back to return to the relevant step and correct it
  3. When everything is correct, click Set up your account

After clicking Set up your account, MOS registers your group details and redirects you to create or sign in to your Microsoft account. This account becomes your MOS owner login.

Note

The next screen is Microsoft's account creation or sign-in page (Azure B2C). If you already have a Microsoft account with the same email address you entered, you may be prompted to sign in. If not, you will be guided through creating a new account. This step is handled entirely by Microsoft — MOS does not see or store your password.

docs.title: Payment Page
docs.text:
After your account is created or signed in, you are returned to MOS and shown the Welcome to MOS! page to complete payment.

This page displays:

  • Your organisation's name, short name, sport, and country
  • A full price breakdown of your selected plan
  • The Year 1 total and Year 2+ renewal price
  • A reminder that this is a 30-day free trial and no charge applies today

Steps

  1. Review your plan summary to confirm it matches what you selected
  2. Click Proceed to payment
  3. You are taken to Stripe's secure checkout page
  4. Enter your card details on the Stripe page
  5. Complete the payment form and confirm

Note

All payment information is entered directly on Stripe's secure page. MOS never receives or stores your card details.

If you close the Stripe checkout page without completing payment, you are returned to the payment page and can try again. No charge is made.

docs.title: Success Page
docs.text:
After Stripe confirms your payment details, you are returned to MOS and shown a success screen:

Your group is being set up Payment received. Your group will be ready within a few seconds. Check your email for confirmation and next steps.

Steps

  1. Wait a few seconds for your group to be provisioned
  2. Check your email inbox for a confirmation message with next steps
  3. Click Sign in to your group to log in and start adding your officials

docs.title: Tips
docs.text:
• The wizard saves your progress within the same browser session. If you accidentally navigate away before Step 4, you will need to start again.
  • Your 30-day free trial begins from the day your group is activated. Cancel any time before the trial ends and you will not be charged.
  • After signing in for the first time, visit Admin > Group Settings to configure your group's options.
  • You can increase or decrease your user blocks and subgroup blocks at any time from Admin > Billing.

docs.title: "That short name is already in use"
docs.text: Another MOS organisation is already using the short name you entered. Choose a different short code and try again.

docs.title: Pricing does not load on Step 3
docs.text:
Symptoms

  • The message "Loading pricing…" stays on screen and never changes

How to fix

  1. Refresh the page (you will need to restart the wizard from Step 1)
  2. Check your internet connection
  3. Try a different browser

docs.title: "Your signup session has expired or could not be found"
docs.text:
This message appears on the payment page if too much time has passed between completing the wizard and arriving at the payment page, or if there was a problem during account creation.

How to fix

  1. Click the link in the error message to start the signup process again
  2. Complete all steps without a long pause between them

docs.title: The Stripe checkout page shows an error
docs.text:
If Stripe shows an error when you try to complete payment:

  1. Check that your card details are entered correctly
  2. Try a different card
  3. Contact your bank if the card is being declined
  4. Contact Cortana Design at mos@matchofficialsystem.com if the problem persists

docs.title: No confirmation email received
docs.text:
1. Check your spam or junk folder
  2. Verify the email address you entered in Step 1 was correct
  3. Wait up to five minutes, then check again
  4. Contact Cortana Design at mos@matchofficialsystem.com if no email arrives

docs.title: JavaScript Required
docs.text:
JavaScript must be enabled in your browser to use the Match Official System. The system relies heavily on JavaScript for interactive features including:

  • Assessments and form submissions
  • Real-time data updates
  • File uploads and downloads
  • Dynamic content loading
  • Auto-save functionality

If you see a blank page or error messages: Check that JavaScript is enabled in your browser settings.

docs.title: Browser Compatibility
docs.text:
While other browsers may work, Chrome and Edge provide the best experience. If you experience issues with another browser, try one of the recommended options above.

Voice dictation requires a supported browser and a working microphone. For the most reliable experience, use the latest Chrome or Edge and allow microphone access when prompted. Some browser speech-recognition services also require an internet connection. Browsers without speech-recognition support do not show the microphone button.

Supported JavaScript versions: ES6+

docs.title: Hardware Requirements
docs.text:
• Processor: Any modern processor (Intel/AMD)
  • RAM: Minimum 1 GB (4 GB recommended)
  • Storage: Minimal; files are stored in the cloud
  • Microphone: Required only for voice dictation
  • Internet Connection: Broadband recommended (minimum 1 Mbps for file uploads)

Captured 25 October 2026.

docs.title: Mobile Devices
docs.text:
The system is optimised for desktop and tablet use. Mobile phone access is supported but may have limited functionality depending on screen size.

For best mobile experience:

  • Use a tablet (iPad, Android tablet) when possible
  • Use landscape orientation on some pages.
  • Consider switching to a desktop browser for complex assessments

docs.text:

  • Firewall: May need to whitelist matchofficialsystem.com
  • Proxy servers: May require configuration in some corporate networks
  • Cookie support: Must be enabled in your browser

docs.title: Accessibility
docs.text:
The system supports:

  • Screen reader compatible pages
  • Keyboard navigation
  • High contrast modes
  • Font size adjustment (browser zoom)
  • Mobile and tablet layouts

For accessibility assistance: Contact your administrator or see FAQ

docs.text:
1. Clear browser cache and cookies
  2. Disable browser extensions temporarily
  3. Try a different browser
  4. Check your internet connection
  5. Contact your administrator if the problem persists

docs.title: Slow performance
docs.text:
1. Close other browser tabs and applications
  2. Clear browser cache
  3. Try upgrading your internet connection
  4. Use a wired connection instead of WiFi if possible

docs.title: Features not working
docs.text:
1. Ensure JavaScript is enabled
  2. Update your browser to the latest version
  3. Disable browser extensions temporarily
  4. Try in a private/incognito browsing window
  5. Try a different browser

docs.title: Large file uploads failing

1. Check your internet connection
  2. Use a wired connection instead of WiFi
  3. Reduce file size if possible
  4. Try uploading during off-peak hours
  5. Contact your administrator for large file options

docs.title: Trainer: Complete Scenario Training
docs.text:
Access Level

You must be signed in and Trainer must be available to your role and group.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Trainer lets you practise realistic situations, write free-form responses, and receive coaching feedback. Packs contain scenarios prepared and approved by your trainers.

How to access

Click Learning then Trainer.

docs.title: Training Packs
docs.text:
Each available pack shows its name, description, number of scenarios, and status.

Statuses may include:

  • Available - You can start the pack.
  • In Progress - You have an unfinished attempt.
  • Feedback pending or Awaiting review - A trainer must release feedback.
  • Completed - Every scenario has been submitted.

Only active packs assigned to your group or subgroup appear.

docs.title: Start a Pack
docs.text:
1. Find an available pack.
  2. Read its description and number of scenarios.
  3. Click Start this pack.
  4. Wait while the pack opens.
  5. Result: The Pack brief and first scenario appear.

You can have only one in-progress attempt for the same pack. Open or delete the existing attempt before starting again.

docs.title: Complete a Scenario
docs.text:
1. Read the Pack brief when one is provided.
  2. Select a scenario from the numbered scenario buttons.
  3. Read the scenario prompt.
  4. Review What a strong answer should cover when it is displayed.
  5. Enter your response under Your answer.
  6. Click Save progress if you want to continue later.
  7. When your answer is final, click Submit final answer.
  8. Result: The scenario is marked Completed and your answer is locked.

An answer is required before submission. Submitted answers cannot be edited.

docs.title: Continue an In-Progress Pack
docs.text:
1. Find the pack marked In Progress.
  2. Click Open.
  3. Select an unfinished scenario.
  4. Continue your saved response.
  5. Save progress or submit the final answer.

The progress badge shows how many scenarios you have completed.

docs.title: View Coaching Feedback
docs.text:
Feedback handling depends on the pack:

  • For standard packs, coaching feedback appears after you submit the answer.
  • For manually reviewed packs, the page displays a message that feedback is waiting for trainer review. You receive an email when it is released.

To review feedback later:

  1. Find the completed pack.
  2. Click Open.
  3. Open each scenario to review your response, score, and released coaching feedback.

docs.title: Delete an In-Progress Attempt
docs.text:
1. Find the pack marked In Progress.
  2. Click Delete.
  3. In Delete In-Progress Attempt, click Delete.
  4. Result: The unfinished attempt is removed and you can start the pack again.

Completed sessions cannot be deleted from this page.

docs.title: Trainer is not available
docs.text: Your role, group settings, or subscription may not include Trainer. Contact your trainer or group administrator.

docs.title: No training packs are available
docs.text:
Your trainer may still need to activate a pack or assign one to your group or subgroup.

Captured 25 October 2026.

docs.title: Your answer will not submit
docs.text: Enter an answer before clicking Submit final answer.

docs.title: Feedback has not appeared
docs.text: If the pack requires trainer review, wait for the notification email. The feedback appears after a trainer releases it.

docs.title: Progress was not saved
docs.text: Reopen the scenario and click Save progress before leaving the page. If the problem continues, contact your group administrator.
