docs.title: Demo environment
docs.text:
• New MOS users can request seven days of owner access to the shared demo. They verify their email with a link valid for two hours, then eligible applicants receive sign-in details and the date their access ends; the registration page explains if a browser or network blocks its security check.
  • Owners of an existing MOS association can sign in and select MOS Demo from the organisation switcher; MOS grants temporary owner access automatically, so they do not need to register separately.
  • The demo organisation is preloaded with fictional officials, matches, reviews, plans, appointments and example files. Its sample content is restored daily, clearing changes made during the day, and other people may be using the demo at the same time.
  • Demo owners can search fictional official profiles, filter them by role, and preview the pages and actions available to roles such as Viewer, Reviewer, Trainer and Selector. An on-screen banner identifies the profile being previewed, and owners can exit the preview to return to their account.
  • Demo AI feature controls are enabled by default for roles supported by each feature, so owners can explore the available AI workflows.

docs.title: Appointment Diary linking
docs.text:
• Officials can select one of their Diary entries by teams, date, venue and competition when linking it to an appointment, instead of entering an entry ID.
  • They can also start a new Diary entry from an appointment, with its teams, venue, competition and date filled in automatically.

docs.title: Drafts
docs.text:
• Officials can save a Diary draft and return to edit it later, or save an unfinished Plan and complete it later.
  • Review creators can reopen and continue their own Match Day, Media, Season and Custom review drafts, or delete a draft they no longer need.

docs.title: Organisation switching
docs.text: • Fixed an issue where open tabs could show one organisation while requests used another after switching groups.

docs.title: Review workflows
docs.text:
• Fixed an issue where saved dates could fail to appear when reopening a Diary review draft.
  • Reviewers no longer see or open their own pending Diary entries in their review queue.
  • Viewer-only members no longer see activity entries about reviews that require Reviewer access.
  • Review creation controls and API access now follow the member's assigned role, so Reviewer-only members cannot submit reviews that require Viewer access.

docs.title: Home Summary performance
docs.text: • Fixed an issue that could make Home Summary unusually slow for groups with subgroups.

docs.title: Assessment page titles
docs.text: • Assessment and review pages use the match name in page and browser titles when match details are available.

docs.title: Home activity feed
docs.text: • Related officials' profile pictures appear inline beside their names in recent activity, including when the related official is the signed-in user.

docs.title: Member search
docs.text: • Search results group available member actions by task and explain when editing a member requires Owner access.

docs.title: Dashboard access
docs.text: • Dashboard shortcuts now appear only when the signed-in member can open the linked page or create the relevant assessment.

docs.title: Notification emails
docs.text:
• Review and assignment emails include direct links to the relevant entry and available match, venue, competition, entry type, or date details.
  • New diary and plan submissions include the submitter and entry date, with a link to the submitted entry; appointment emails open the specific appointment and news emails link to the full story.
  • Exam takers receive their result by email, and enabled exam notifications send owners and trainers the result with a question-by-question answer review.

docs.title: Group deletion
docs.text: • Group deletion shows the data being removed, elapsed time, and an error message if deletion fails; shared user accounts are retained while group files are queued for removal.

docs.title: Improvements
docs.text:
• AI summaries now begin with a short overview and separate evidence-based strengths and development points into concise bullet lists, with up to four points in each section.
  • AI summaries show clickable source records with association season names, and include written entries from the previous season when the selected season does not have enough recent evidence.
  • Dark-mode score breakdowns display the calculated score total more clearly.

docs.title: Bug Fixes
docs.text: • Fixed the offline page logo so it remains available when the app is offline.

docs.title: Improvements
docs.text: • The connection error page has a clearer layout, a retry button, and a separate message for temporary server problems.

docs.title: New Features
docs.text:
• Owners of manually billed groups receive licence renewal emails 90, 60, and 30 days before expiry, with the expiry date and renewal options. They can opt out in their profile; the general automated-email opt-out also applies.
  • If a licence remains expired, the owner receives an email 7 days later explaining that access has ended and giving the date the group and its data are scheduled for deletion, 90 days after expiry.

docs.title: New Features
docs.text:
• Read the MOS version history in the app or on the public documentation site.
  • Group owners can manage a separate email preference for major and minor release announcements.

docs.title: Improvements
docs.text:
• Major and minor release announcements are sent after a successful production release, with test mode enabled before live sending.
  • Release announcements go only to owners whose groups have a current MOS licence.

docs.title: New Features
docs.text:
• Group owners can edit completed assessments, diary reviews, and plans while retaining the original reviewer and review date
